meaning: Implementation inventory and explicitly linked behavioral examples, not proof of complete semantic conformance. No linked examples does not mean no tests exist; earlier tests have not all been linked. Opaque expressions and facts absent from core UML remain explicit validation obligations.
scope: Declared core class/property/operation metadata, enumerations, association-owned ends, class invariants, pre/postconditions and XMI descriptions. Additional normative PDF prose still needs separate requirement decomposition; this is not a complete census of every normative UML requirement.

definitions.name: Activity.maximum_one_parameter_node
descriptions: A Parameter with direction other than inout must have exactly one ActivityParameterNode in an Activity.

expressions.body:
ownedParameter->forAll(p | 
   p.direction <> ParameterDirectionKind::inout implies node->select(
       oclIsKindOf(ActivityParameterNode) and oclAsType(ActivityParameterNode).parameter = p)->size()= 1)

definitions.name: Activity.maximum_two_parameter_nodes
descriptions: A Parameter with direction inout must have exactly two ActivityParameterNodes in an Activity, at most one with incoming ActivityEdges and at most one with outgoing ActivityEdges.

expressions.body:
ownedParameter->forAll(p | 
p.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::inout implies
let associatedNodes : Set(ActivityNode) = node->select(
       oclIsKindOf(ActivityParameterNode) and oclAsType(ActivityParameterNode).parameter = p) in 
  associatedNodes->size()=2 and
  associatedNodes->select(incoming->notEmpty())->size()<=1 and
  associatedNodes->select(outgoing->notEmpty())->size()<=1
)

definitions.name: Activity.edge
descriptions: ActivityEdges expressing flow between the nodes of the Activity.

definitions.name: Activity.group
descriptions: Top-level ActivityGroups in the Activity.

definitions.name: Activity.isReadOnly
descriptions: If true, this Activity must not make any changes to objects. The default is false (an Activity may make nonlocal changes). (This is an assertion, not an executable property. It may be used by an execution engine to optimize model execution. If the assertion is violated by the Activity, then the model is ill-formed.)

definitions.name: Activity.isSingleExecution
descriptions: If true, all invocations of the Activity are handled by the same execution.

definitions.name: Activity.node
descriptions: ActivityNodes coordinated by the Activity.

definitions.name: Activity.partition
descriptions: Top-level ActivityPartitions in the Activity.

definitions.name: Activity.structuredNode
descriptions: Top-level StructuredActivityNodes in the Activity.

definitions.name: Activity.variable
descriptions: Top-level Variables defined by the Activity.

definitions.name: Activity
descriptions: An Activity is the specification of parameterized Behavior as the coordinated sequencing of subordinate units.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.source_and_target
descriptions: If an ActivityEdge is directly owned by an Activity, then its source and target must be directly or indirectly contained in the same Activity.

expressions.body: activity<>null implies source.containingActivity() = activity and target.containingActivity() = activity

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.activity
descriptions: The Activity containing the ActivityEdge, if it is directly owned by an Activity.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.guard
descriptions: A ValueSpecification that is evaluated to determine if a token can traverse the ActivityEdge. If an ActivityEdge has no guard, then there is no restriction on tokens traversing the edge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.inGroup
descriptions: ActivityGroups containing the ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.inPartition
descriptions: ActivityPartitions containing the ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.inStructuredNode
descriptions: The StructuredActivityNode containing the ActivityEdge, if it is owned by a StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.interrupts
descriptions: The InterruptibleActivityRegion for which this ActivityEdge is an interruptingEdge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.redefinedEdge
descriptions: ActivityEdges from a generalization of the Activity containing this ActivityEdge that are redefined by this ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.source
descriptions: The ActivityNode from which tokens are taken when they traverse the ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.target
descriptions: The ActivityNode to which tokens are put when they traverse the ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge.weight
descriptions: The minimum number of tokens that must traverse the ActivityEdge at the same time. If no weight is specified, this is equivalent to specifying a constant value of 1.

definitions.name: ActivityEdge
descriptions: An ActivityEdge is an abstract class for directed connections between two ActivityNodes.

definitions.name: ActivityFinalNode
descriptions: An ActivityFinalNode is a FinalNode that terminates the execution of its owning Activity or StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.containingActivity
descriptions: The Activity that directly or indirectly contains this ActivityGroup.

expressions.body:
result = (if superGroup<>null then superGroup.containingActivity()
else inActivity
endif)

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.nodes_and_edges
descriptions: All containedNodes and containeEdges of an ActivityGroup must be in the same Activity as the group.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.not_contained
descriptions: No containedNode or containedEdge of an ActivityGroup may be contained by its subgroups or its superGroups, transitively.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.containedEdge
descriptions: ActivityEdges immediately contained in the ActivityGroup.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.containedNode
descriptions: ActivityNodes immediately contained in the ActivityGroup.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.inActivity
descriptions: The Activity containing the ActivityGroup, if it is directly owned by an Activity.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.subgroup
descriptions: Other ActivityGroups immediately contained in this ActivityGroup.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup.superGroup
descriptions: The ActivityGroup immediately containing this ActivityGroup, if it is directly owned by another ActivityGroup.

definitions.name: ActivityGroup
descriptions: ActivityGroup is an abstract class for defining sets of ActivityNodes and ActivityEdges in an Activity.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.containingActivity
descriptions: The Activity that directly or indirectly contains this ActivityNode.

expressions.body:
result = (if inStructuredNode<>null then inStructuredNode.containingActivity()
else activity
endif)

definitions.name: ActivityNode.activity
descriptions: The Activity containing the ActivityNode, if it is directly owned by an Activity.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.inGroup
descriptions: ActivityGroups containing the ActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.inInterruptibleRegion
descriptions: InterruptibleActivityRegions containing the ActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.inPartition
descriptions: ActivityPartitions containing the ActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.inStructuredNode
descriptions: The StructuredActivityNode containing the ActvityNode, if it is directly owned by a StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.incoming
descriptions: ActivityEdges that have the ActivityNode as their target.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.outgoing
descriptions: ActivityEdges that have the ActivityNode as their source.

definitions.name: ActivityNode.redefinedNode
descriptions: ActivityNodes from a generalization of the Activity containining this ActivityNode that are redefined by this ActivityNode.

definitions.name: ActivityNode
descriptions: ActivityNode is an abstract class for points in the flow of an Activity connected by ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode.no_outgoing_edges
descriptions: An ActivityParameterNode with no outgoing ActivityEdges and one or more incoming ActivityEdges must have a parameter with direction out, inout, or return.

expressions.body:
(incoming->notEmpty() and outgoing->isEmpty()) implies 
	(parameter.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::out or 
	 parameter.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::inout or 
	 parameter.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::return)

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode.has_parameters
descriptions: The parameter of an ActivityParameterNode must be from the containing Activity.

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode.same_type
descriptions: The type of an ActivityParameterNode is the same as the type of its parameter.

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode.no_incoming_edges
descriptions: An ActivityParameterNode with no incoming ActivityEdges and one or more outgoing ActivityEdges must have a parameter with direction in or inout.

expressions.body:
(outgoing->notEmpty() and incoming->isEmpty()) implies 
	(parameter.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::_'in' or 
	 parameter.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::inout)

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode.no_edges
descriptions: An ActivityParameterNode may have all incoming ActivityEdges or all outgoing ActivityEdges, but it must not have both incoming and outgoing ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode.parameter
descriptions: The Parameter for which the ActivityParameterNode will be accepting or providing values.

definitions.name: ActivityParameterNode
descriptions: An ActivityParameterNode is an ObjectNode for accepting values from the input Parameters or providing values to the output Parameters of an Activity.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.represents_classifier
descriptions: If a non-external ActivityPartition represents a Classifier and has a superPartition, then the superPartition must represent a Classifier, and the Classifier of the subpartition must be nested (nestedClassifier or ownedBehavior) in the Classifier represented by the superPartition, or be at the contained end of a composition Association with the Classifier represented by the superPartition.

expressions.body:
(not isExternal and represents.oclIsKindOf(Classifier) and superPartition->notEmpty()) implies
(
   let representedClassifier : Classifier = represents.oclAsType(Classifier) in
     superPartition.represents.oclIsKindOf(Classifier) and
      let representedSuperClassifier : Classifier = superPartition.represents.oclAsType(Classifier) in
       (representedSuperClassifier.oclIsKindOf(BehavioredClassifier) and representedClassifier.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) and 
        representedSuperClassifier.oclAsType(BehavioredClassifier).ownedBehavior->includes(representedClassifier.oclAsType(Behavior))) 
       or
       (representedSuperClassifier.oclIsKindOf(Class) and  representedSuperClassifier.oclAsType(Class).nestedClassifier->includes(representedClassifier))
       or
       (Association.allInstances()->exists(a | a.memberEnd->exists(end1 | end1.isComposite and end1.type = representedClassifier and 
                                                                      a.memberEnd->exists(end2 | end1<>end2 and end2.type = representedSuperClassifier))))
)

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.represents_property_and_is_contained
descriptions: If an ActivityPartition represents a Property and has a superPartition, then the Property must be of a Classifier represented by the superPartition, or of a Classifier that is the type of a Property represented by the superPartition.

expressions.body:
(represents.oclIsKindOf(Property) and superPartition->notEmpty()) implies
(
  (superPartition.represents.oclIsKindOf(Classifier) and represents.owner = superPartition.represents) or 
  (superPartition.represents.oclIsKindOf(Property) and represents.owner = superPartition.represents.oclAsType(Property).type)
)

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.represents_property
descriptions: If an ActivityPartition represents a Property and has a superPartition representing a Classifier, then all the other non-external subpartitions of the superPartition must represent Properties directly owned by the same Classifier.

expressions.body:
(represents.oclIsKindOf(Property) and superPartition->notEmpty() and superPartition.represents.oclIsKindOf(Classifier)) implies
(
  let representedClassifier : Classifier = superPartition.represents.oclAsType(Classifier)
  in
    superPartition.subpartition->reject(isExternal)->forAll(p | 
       p.represents.oclIsKindOf(Property) and p.owner=representedClassifier)
)

definitions.limitation: The source tests the partition owner against the represented classifier. Python tests the represented Property owner as required by the prose.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.dimension_not_contained
descriptions: An ActvivityPartition with isDimension = true may not be contained by another ActivityPartition.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.edge
descriptions: ActivityEdges immediately contained in the ActivityPartition.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.isDimension
descriptions: Indicates whether the ActivityPartition groups other ActivityPartitions along a dimension.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.isExternal
descriptions: Indicates whether the ActivityPartition represents an entity to which the partitioning structure does not apply.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.node
descriptions: ActivityNodes immediately contained in the ActivityPartition.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.represents
descriptions: An Element represented by the functionality modeled within the ActivityPartition.

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.subpartition
descriptions: Other ActivityPartitions immediately contained in this ActivityPartition (as its subgroups).

definitions.name: ActivityPartition.superPartition
descriptions: Other ActivityPartitions immediately containing this ActivityPartition (as its superGroups).

definitions.name: ActivityPartition
descriptions: An ActivityPartition is a kind of ActivityGroup for identifying ActivityNodes that have some characteristic in common.

definitions.name: CentralBufferNode
descriptions: A CentralBufferNode is an ObjectNode for managing flows from multiple sources and targets.

definitions.name: ControlFlow.object_nodes
descriptions: ControlFlows may not have ObjectNodes at either end, except for ObjectNodes with control type.

definitions.name: ControlFlow
descriptions: A ControlFlow is an ActivityEdge traversed by control tokens or object tokens of control type, which are use to control the execution of ExecutableNodes.

definitions.name: ControlNode
descriptions: A ControlNode is an abstract ActivityNode that coordinates flows in an Activity.

definitions.name: DataStoreNode
descriptions: A DataStoreNode is a CentralBufferNode for persistent data.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.zero_input_parameters
descriptions: If the DecisionNode has no decisionInputFlow and an incoming ControlFlow, then any decisionInput Behavior has no in parameters.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.edges
descriptions: The ActivityEdges incoming to and outgoing from a DecisionNode, other than the decisionInputFlow (if any), must be either all ObjectFlows or all ControlFlows.

expressions.body:
let allEdges: Set(ActivityEdge) = incoming->union(outgoing) in
let allRelevantEdges: Set(ActivityEdge) = if decisionInputFlow->notEmpty() then allEdges->excluding(decisionInputFlow) else allEdges endif in
allRelevantEdges->forAll(oclIsKindOf(ControlFlow)) or allRelevantEdges->forAll(oclIsKindOf(ObjectFlow))

definitions.name: DecisionNode.decision_input_flow_incoming
descriptions: The decisionInputFlow of a DecisionNode must be an incoming ActivityEdge of the DecisionNode.
definitions.limitation: The source requires incoming to contain null for an absent optional decisionInputFlow. Python applies the membership check only when that flow exists.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.two_input_parameters
descriptions: If the DecisionNode has a decisionInputFlow and an second incoming ObjectFlow, then any decisionInput has two in Parameters, the first of which has a type that is the same as or a supertype of the type of object tokens offered on the non-decisionInputFlow and the second of which has a type that is the same as or a supertype of the type of object tokens offered on the decisionInputFlow.
definitions.limitation: The XMI count predicate is preserved. validate() additionally enforces ordered regular/decision-flow input types through prose:DecisionNode.input_types; unrepresented token types remain unsupported.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.incoming_outgoing_edges
descriptions: A DecisionNode has one or two incoming ActivityEdges and at least one outgoing ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.incoming_control_one_input_parameter
descriptions: If the DecisionNode has a decisionInputFlow and an incoming ControlFlow, then any decisionInput Behavior has one in Parameter whose type is the same as or a supertype of the type of object tokens offered on the decisionInputFlow.
definitions.limitation: The XMI count predicate is preserved. validate() additionally enforces decisionInputFlow token-type conformance through prose:DecisionNode.input_types; unrepresented types remain unsupported.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.parameters
descriptions: A decisionInput Behavior has no out parameters, no inout parameters, and one return parameter.

expressions.body:
decisionInput<>null implies 
  (decisionInput.ownedParameter->forAll(par | 
     par.direction <> ParameterDirectionKind::out and 
     par.direction <> ParameterDirectionKind::inout ) and
   decisionInput.ownedParameter->one(par | 
     par.direction <> ParameterDirectionKind::return))

definitions.limitation: The source counts non-return parameters. Python requires exactly one return parameter according to the prose.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.incoming_object_one_input_parameter
descriptions: If the DecisionNode has no decisionInputFlow and an incoming ObjectFlow, then any decisionInput Behavior has one in Parameter whose type is the same as or a supertype of the type of object tokens offered on the incoming ObjectFlow.
definitions.limitation: The XMI count predicate is preserved. validate() additionally enforces the sole object input type through prose:DecisionNode.input_types; unrepresented types remain unsupported.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.decisionInput
descriptions: A Behavior that is executed to provide an input to guard ValueSpecifications on ActivityEdges outgoing from the DecisionNode.

definitions.name: DecisionNode.decisionInputFlow
descriptions: An additional ActivityEdge incoming to the DecisionNode that provides a decision input value for the guards ValueSpecifications on ActivityEdges outgoing from the DecisionNode.

definitions.name: DecisionNode
descriptions: A DecisionNode is a ControlNode that chooses between outgoing ActivityEdges for the routing of tokens.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.handler_body_edges
descriptions: The handlerBody has no incoming or outgoing ActivityEdges and the exceptionInput has no incoming ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.output_pins
descriptions: If the protectedNode is an Action with OutputPins, then the handlerBody must also be an Action with the same number of OutputPins, which are compatible in type, ordering, and multiplicity to those of the protectedNode.

expressions.body:
(protectedNode.oclIsKindOf(Action) and protectedNode.oclAsType(Action).output->notEmpty()) implies
(
  handlerBody.oclIsKindOf(Action) and 
  let protectedNodeOutput : OrderedSet(OutputPin) = protectedNode.oclAsType(Action).output,
        handlerBodyOutput : OrderedSet(OutputPin) =  handlerBody.oclAsType(Action).output in
    protectedNodeOutput->size() = handlerBodyOutput->size() and
    Sequence{1..protectedNodeOutput->size()}->forAll(i |
    	handlerBodyOutput->at(i).type.conformsTo(protectedNodeOutput->at(i).type) and
    	handlerBodyOutput->at(i).isOrdered=protectedNodeOutput->at(i).isOrdered and
    	handlerBodyOutput->at(i).compatibleWith(protectedNodeOutput->at(i)))
)

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.one_input
descriptions: The handlerBody is an Action with one InputPin, and that InputPin is the same as the exceptionInput.

expressions.body:
handlerBody.oclIsKindOf(Action) and
let inputs: OrderedSet(InputPin) = handlerBody.oclAsType(Action).input in
inputs->size()=1 and inputs->first()=exceptionInput

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.edge_source_target
descriptions: An ActivityEdge that has a source within the handlerBody of an ExceptionHandler must have its target in the handlerBody also, and vice versa.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.handler_body_owner
descriptions: The handlerBody must have the same owner as the protectedNode.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.exception_input_type
descriptions: The exceptionInput must either have no type or every exceptionType must conform to the exceptionInput type.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.exceptionInput
descriptions: An ObjectNode within the handlerBody. When the ExceptionHandler catches an exception, the exception token is placed on this ObjectNode, causing the handlerBody to execute.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.exceptionType
descriptions: The Classifiers whose instances the ExceptionHandler catches as exceptions. If an exception occurs whose type is any exceptionType, the ExceptionHandler catches the exception and executes the handlerBody.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.handlerBody
descriptions: An ExecutableNode that is executed if the ExceptionHandler catches an exception.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler.protectedNode
descriptions: The ExecutableNode protected by the ExceptionHandler. If an exception propagates out of the protectedNode and has a type matching one of the exceptionTypes, then it is caught by this ExceptionHandler.

definitions.name: ExceptionHandler
descriptions: An ExceptionHandler is an Element that specifies a handlerBody ExecutableNode to execute in case the specified exception occurs during the execution of the protected ExecutableNode.

definitions.name: ExecutableNode.handler
descriptions: A set of ExceptionHandlers that are examined if an exception propagates out of the ExceptionNode.

definitions.name: ExecutableNode
descriptions: An ExecutableNode is an abstract class for ActivityNodes whose execution may be controlled using ControlFlows and to which ExceptionHandlers may be attached.

definitions.name: FinalNode.no_outgoing_edges
descriptions: A FinalNode has no outgoing ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: FinalNode
descriptions: A FinalNode is an abstract ControlNode at which a flow in an Activity stops.

definitions.name: FlowFinalNode
descriptions: A FlowFinalNode is a FinalNode that terminates a flow by consuming the tokens offered to it.

definitions.name: ForkNode.edges
descriptions: The ActivityEdges incoming to and outgoing from a ForkNode must be either all ObjectFlows or all ControlFlows.

expressions.body:
let allEdges : Set(ActivityEdge) = incoming->union(outgoing) in
allEdges->forAll(oclIsKindOf(ControlFlow)) or allEdges->forAll(oclIsKindOf(ObjectFlow))

definitions.name: ForkNode.one_incoming_edge
descriptions: A ForkNode has one incoming ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: ForkNode
descriptions: A ForkNode is a ControlNode that splits a flow into multiple concurrent flows.

definitions.name: InitialNode.no_incoming_edges
descriptions: An InitialNode has no incoming ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: InitialNode.control_edges
descriptions: All the outgoing ActivityEdges from an InitialNode must be ControlFlows.

definitions.name: InitialNode
descriptions: An InitialNode is a ControlNode that offers a single control token when initially enabled.

definitions.name: InterruptibleActivityRegion.interrupting_edges
descriptions: The interruptingEdges of an InterruptibleActivityRegion must have their source in the region and their target outside the region, but within the same Activity containing the region.

expressions.body:
interruptingEdge->forAll(edge | 
  node->includes(edge.source) and node->excludes(edge.target) and edge.target.containingActivity() = inActivity)

definitions.name: InterruptibleActivityRegion.interruptingEdge
descriptions: The ActivityEdges leaving the InterruptibleActivityRegion on which a traversing token will result in the termination of other tokens flowing in the InterruptibleActivityRegion.

definitions.name: InterruptibleActivityRegion.node
descriptions: ActivityNodes immediately contained in the InterruptibleActivityRegion.

definitions.name: InterruptibleActivityRegion
descriptions: An InterruptibleActivityRegion is an ActivityGroup that supports the termination of tokens flowing in the portions of an activity within it.

definitions.name: JoinNode.one_outgoing_edge
descriptions: A JoinNode has one outgoing ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: JoinNode.incoming_object_flow
descriptions: If one of the incoming ActivityEdges of a JoinNode is an ObjectFlow, then its outgoing ActivityEdge must be an ObjectFlow. Otherwise its outgoing ActivityEdge must be a ControlFlow.

definitions.name: JoinNode.isCombineDuplicate
descriptions: Indicates whether incoming tokens having objects with the same identity are combined into one by the JoinNode.

definitions.name: JoinNode.joinSpec
descriptions: A ValueSpecification giving the condition under which the JoinNode will offer a token on its outgoing ActivityEdge. If no joinSpec is specified, then the JoinNode will offer an outgoing token if tokens are offered on all of its incoming ActivityEdges (an "and" condition).

definitions.name: JoinNode
descriptions: A JoinNode is a ControlNode that synchronizes multiple flows.

definitions.name: MergeNode.one_outgoing_edge
descriptions: A MergeNode has one outgoing ActivityEdge.

definitions.name: MergeNode.edges
descriptions: The ActivityEdges incoming to and outgoing from a MergeNode must be either all ObjectFlows or all ControlFlows.

expressions.body:
let allEdges : Set(ActivityEdge) = incoming->union(outgoing) in
allEdges->forAll(oclIsKindOf(ControlFlow)) or allEdges->forAll(oclIsKindOf(ObjectFlow))

definitions.name: MergeNode
descriptions: A merge node is a control node that brings together multiple alternate flows. It is not used to synchronize concurrent flows but to accept one among several alternate flows.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.input_and_output_parameter
descriptions: A selection Behavior has one input Parameter and one output Parameter. The input Parameter must have the same as or a supertype of the type of the source ObjectNode, be non-unique and have multiplicity 0..*. The output Parameter must be the same or a subtype of the type of source ObjectNode. The Behavior cannot have side effects.

expressions.body:
selection<>null implies
	selection.inputParameters()->size()=1 and
	selection.inputParameters()->forAll(not isUnique and is(0,*)) and
	selection.outputParameters()->size()=1

definitions.limitation: The XMI count/bounds predicate is preserved. validate() additionally enforces selection input/output types through prose:ObjectFlow.selection_types. Behavior purity remains an external evidence obligation.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.no_executable_nodes
descriptions: ObjectFlows may not have ExecutableNodes at either end.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.transformation_behavior
descriptions: A transformation Behavior has one input Parameter and one output Parameter. The input Parameter must be the same as or a supertype of the type of object token coming from the source end. The output Parameter must be the same or a subtype of the type of object token expected downstream. The Behavior cannot have side effects.
definitions.limitation: The XMI count predicate is preserved. validate() additionally enforces upstream/input and output/downstream conformance through prose:ObjectFlow.transformation_types. Behavior purity remains an external evidence obligation.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.selection_behavior
descriptions: An ObjectFlow may have a selection Behavior only if it has an ObjectNode as its source.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.compatible_types
descriptions: ObjectNodes connected by an ObjectFlow, with optionally intervening ControlNodes, must have compatible types. In particular, the downstream ObjectNode type must be the same or a supertype of the upstream ObjectNode type.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.same_upper_bounds
descriptions: ObjectNodes connected by an ObjectFlow, with optionally intervening ControlNodes, must have the same upperBounds.
definitions.limitation: Represented UnlimitedNatural bounds are compared along object-flow paths through ControlNodes. Unknown numeric expressions require an evaluator; invalid computable literal kinds are diagnosed.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.target
descriptions: An ObjectFlow with a constant weight may not target an ObjectNode, with optionally intervening ControlNodes, that has an upper bound less than the weight.
definitions.limitation: Constant Integer weights are compared with downstream bounds. Unknown constancy requires analyzer facts; known nonconstant weights are outside this rule, while unevaluated constants remain unsupported.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.is_multicast_or_is_multireceive
descriptions: isMulticast and isMultireceive cannot both be true.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.isMulticast
descriptions: Indicates whether the objects in the ObjectFlow are passed by multicasting.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.isMultireceive
descriptions: Indicates whether the objects in the ObjectFlow are gathered from respondents to multicasting.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.selection
descriptions: A Behavior used to select tokens from a source ObjectNode.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow.transformation
descriptions: A Behavior used to change or replace object tokens flowing along the ObjectFlow.

definitions.name: ObjectFlow
descriptions: An ObjectFlow is an ActivityEdge that is traversed by object tokens that may hold values. Object flows also support multicast/receive, token selection from object nodes, and transformation of tokens.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.input_output_parameter
descriptions: A selection Behavior has one input Parameter and one output Parameter. The input Parameter must have the same type as  or a supertype of the type of ObjectNode, be non-unique, and have multiplicity 0..*. The output Parameter must be the same or a subtype of the type of ObjectNode. The Behavior cannot have side effects.

expressions.body:
selection<>null implies
	selection.inputParameters()->size()=1 and
	selection.inputParameters()->forAll(p | not p.isUnique and p.is(0,*) and self.type.conformsTo(p.type)) and
	selection.outputParameters()->size()=1 and
		selection.inputParameters()->forAll(p | self.type.conformsTo(p.type))

definitions.limitation: Input/output counts, multiplicities and nominal type variance are checked (with a documented source-body correction). Absence of side effects of the selection Behavior is not proved.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.selection_behavior
descriptions: If an ObjectNode has a selection Behavior, then the ordering of the object node is ordered, and vice versa.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.object_flow_edges
descriptions: If isControlType=false, the ActivityEdges incoming to or outgoing from an ObjectNode must all be ObjectFlows.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.inState
descriptions: The States required to be associated with the values held by tokens on this ObjectNode.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.isControlType
descriptions: Indicates whether the type of the ObjectNode is to be treated as representing control values that may traverse ControlFlows.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.ordering
descriptions: Indicates how the tokens held by the ObjectNode are ordered for selection to traverse ActivityEdges outgoing from the ObjectNode.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.selection
descriptions: A Behavior used to select tokens to be offered on outgoing ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: ObjectNode.upperBound
descriptions: The maximum number of tokens that may be held by this ObjectNode. Tokens cannot flow into the ObjectNode if the upperBound is reached. If no upperBound is specified, then there is no limit on how many tokens the ObjectNode can hold.

definitions.name: ObjectNode
descriptions: An ObjectNode is an abstract ActivityNode that may hold tokens within the object flow in an Activity. ObjectNodes also support token selection, limitation on the number of tokens held, specification of the state required for tokens being held, and carrying control values.

definitions.name: Variable.isAccessibleBy
descriptions: A Variable is accessible by Actions within its scope (the Activity or StructuredActivityNode that owns it).

expressions.body:
result = (if scope<>null then scope.allOwnedNodes()->includes(a)
else a.containingActivity()=activityScope
endif)

definitions.name: Variable.activityScope
descriptions: An Activity that owns the Variable.

definitions.name: Variable.scope
descriptions: A StructuredActivityNode that owns the Variable.

definitions.name: Variable
descriptions: A Variable is a ConnectableElement that may store values during the execution of an Activity. Reading and writing the values of a Variable provides an alternative means for passing data than the use of ObjectFlows. A Variable may be owned directly by an Activity, in which case it is accessible from anywhere within that activity, or it may be owned by a StructuredActivityNode, in which case it is only accessible within that node.

definitions.name: Duration.no_expr_requires_observation
descriptions: If a Duration has no expr, then it must have a single observation that is a DurationObservation.

definitions.name: Duration.expr
descriptions: A ValueSpecification that evaluates to the value of the Duration.

definitions.name: Duration.observation
descriptions: Refers to the Observations that are involved in the computation of the Duration value

definitions.name: Duration

definitions.name: DurationInterval.min

definitions.name: DurationInterval

definitions.name: DurationObservation.first_event_multiplicity

definitions.name: DurationObservation.firstEvent

If firstEvent[i] is false, then the corresponding observation event is the time instant the execution exits event[i].
definitions.limitation: The source defaults to unordered and unique Boolean values. Repeated first-event flags collapse; ordered event-pair interpretation is unresolved.

definitions.name: DurationObservation
descriptions: A DurationObservation is a reference to a duration during an execution. It points out the NamedElement(s) in the model to observe and whether the observations are when this NamedElement is entered or when it is exited.

definitions.name: Interval.max

definitions.name: OpaqueExpression.value

definitions.name: OpaqueExpression.one_return_result_parameter

definitions.name: OpaqueExpression.behavior
descriptions: Specifies the behavior of the OpaqueExpression as a UML Behavior.

descriptions: Specifies the languages used to express the textual bodies of the OpaqueExpression.  Languages are matched to body Strings by order. The interpretation of the body depends on the languages. If the languages are unspecified, they may be implicit from the expression body or the context.

definitions.name: OpaqueExpression.result

definitions.name: OpaqueExpression
descriptions: An OpaqueExpression is a ValueSpecification that specifies the computation of a collection of values either in terms of a UML Behavior or based on a textual statement in a language other than UML

definitions.name: StringExpression.stringValue

result = (if subExpression->notEmpty()

definitions.name: StringExpression

definitions.name: TimeConstraint.has_one_constrainedElement

definitions.name: TimeInterval.min

definitions.name: TimeObservation.event
descriptions: The TimeObservation is determined by the entering or exiting of the event Element during execution.

definitions.name: TimeObservation.firstEvent
descriptions: The value of firstEvent is related to the event. If firstEvent is true, then the corresponding observation event is the first time instant the execution enters the event Element. If firstEvent is false, then the corresponding observation event is the time instant the execution exits the event Element.

definitions.name: TimeObservation
descriptions: A TimeObservation is a reference to a time instant during an execution. It points out the NamedElement in the model to observe and whether the observation is when this NamedElement is entered or when it is exited.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.booleanValue
descriptions: The query booleanValue() gives a single Boolean value when one can be computed.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.integerValue
descriptions: The query integerValue() gives a single Integer value when one can be computed.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.isCompatibleWith
descriptions: The query isCompatibleWith() determines if this ValueSpecification is compatible with the specified ParameterableElement. This ValueSpecification is compatible with ParameterableElement p if the kind of this ValueSpecification is the same as or a subtype of the kind of p. Further, if p is a TypedElement, then the type of this ValueSpecification must be conformant with the type of p.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.isComputable
descriptions: The query isComputable() determines whether a value specification can be computed in a model. This operation cannot be fully defined in OCL. A conforming implementation is expected to deliver true for this operation for all ValueSpecifications that it can compute, and to compute all of those for which the operation is true. A conforming implementation is expected to be able to compute at least the value of all LiteralSpecifications.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.isNull
descriptions: The query isNull() returns true when it can be computed that the value is null.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.realValue
descriptions: The query realValue() gives a single Real value when one can be computed.

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.stringValue

definitions.name: ValueSpecification.unlimitedValue

definitions.name: ValueSpecification
descriptions: A ValueSpecification is the specification of a (possibly empty) set of values. A ValueSpecification is a ParameterableElement that may be exposed as a formal TemplateParameter and provided as the actual parameter in the binding of a template.

definitions.name: Actor.associations
descriptions: An Actor can only have Associations to UseCases, Components, and Classes. Furthermore these Associations must be binary.

expressions.body:
Association.allInstances()->forAll( a |
  a.memberEnd->collect(type)->includes(self) implies
  (
    a.memberEnd->size() = 2 and
    let actorEnd : Property = a.memberEnd->any(type = self) in
      actorEnd.opposite.class.oclIsKindOf(UseCase) or
      ( actorEnd.opposite.class.oclIsKindOf(Class) and not
         actorEnd.opposite.class.oclIsKindOf(Behavior))
      )
  )

definitions.name: Actor.must_have_name

definitions.name: Actor

definitions.name: Extend.extension_points

descriptions: References the condition that must hold when the first ExtensionPoint is reached for the extension to take place. If no constraint is associated with the Extend relationship, the extension is unconditional.

definitions.name: Extend.extendedCase

definitions.name: Extend.extension

definitions.name: Extend.extensionLocation
descriptions: An ordered list of ExtensionPoints belonging to the extended UseCase, specifying where the respective behavioral fragments of the extending UseCase are to be inserted. The first fragment in the extending UseCase is associated with the first extension point in the list, the second fragment with the second point, and so on. Note that, in most practical cases, the extending UseCase has just a single behavior fragment, so that the list of ExtensionPoints is trivial.

definitions.name: Extend
descriptions: A relationship from an extending UseCase to an extended UseCase that specifies how and when the behavior defined in the extending UseCase can be inserted into the behavior defined in the extended UseCase.

definitions.name: ExtensionPoint.must_have_name
descriptions: An ExtensionPoint must have a name.

definitions.name: ExtensionPoint.useCase
descriptions: The UseCase that owns this ExtensionPoint.

definitions.name: ExtensionPoint
descriptions: An ExtensionPoint identifies a point in the behavior of a UseCase where that behavior can be extended by the behavior of some other (extending) UseCase, as specified by an Extend relationship.

definitions.name: Include.addition

definitions.name: Include.includingCase

definitions.name: Include

definitions.name: UseCase.allIncludedUseCases

definitions.name: UseCase.binary_associations

definitions.name: UseCase.cannot_include_self

definitions.name: UseCase.must_have_name
descriptions: A UseCase must have a name.

definitions.name: UseCase.extend

definitions.name: UseCase.extensionPoint

definitions.name: UseCase.include

definitions.name: UseCase.subject

definitions.name: UseCase
descriptions: A UseCase specifies a set of actions performed by its subjects, which yields an observable result that is of value for one or more Actors or other stakeholders of each subject.

definitions.name: Association.endType

definitions.name: Association.specialized_end_number

definitions.name: Association.endType

definitions.name: Association.isDerived

definitions.name: Association.navigableOwnedEnd

definitions.name: Association.ownedEnd

definitions.name: Association
descriptions: A link is a tuple of values that refer to typed objects.  An Association classifies a set of links, each of which is an instance of the Association.  Each value in the link refers to an instance of the type of the corresponding end of the Association.

definitions.name: AssociationClass.cannot_be_defined

definitions.name: AssociationClass.disjoint_attributes_ends

definitions.name: AssociationClass
descriptions: A model element that has both Association and Class properties. An AssociationClass can be seen as an Association that also has Class properties, or as a Class that also has Association properties. It not only connects a set of Classifiers but also defines a set of Features that belong to the Association itself and not to any of the associated Classifiers.

descriptions: This property is used when the Class is acting as a metaclass. It references the Extensions that specify additional properties of the metaclass. The property is derived from the Extensions whose memberEnds are typed by the Class.

definitions.name: Class.isAbstract
descriptions: If true, the Class does not provide a complete declaration and cannot be instantiated. An abstract Class is typically used as a target of Associations or Generalizations.

definitions.name: Class.isActive
descriptions: Determines whether an object specified by this Class is active or not. If true, then the owning Class is referred to as an active Class. If false, then such a Class is referred to as a passive Class.

definitions.name: Class.nestedClassifier
descriptions: The Classifiers owned by the Class that are not ownedBehaviors.

definitions.name: Class.ownedAttribute
descriptions: The attributes (i.e., the Properties) owned by the Class.

definitions.name: Class.ownedOperation

definitions.name: Class.ownedReception
descriptions: The Receptions owned by the Class.

definitions.name: Class.superClass

definitions.name: Class
