definitions.limitation: Foreign expressions require trusted analyzer facts or a declared static Boolean type; execution is not verified.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.value_specification_constant
descriptions: If a non-literal ValueSpecification is used for lowerValue or upperValue, then that specification must be a constant expression.
definitions.limitation: Foreign expressions require trusted analyzer facts or a declared static Boolean type; execution is not verified.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.lower_is_integer
descriptions: If it is not empty, then lowerValue must have an Integer value.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.upper_is_unlimitedNatural
descriptions: If it is not empty, then upperValue must have an UnlimitedNatural value.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.isOrdered
descriptions: For a multivalued multiplicity, this attribute specifies whether the values in an instantiation of this MultiplicityElement are sequentially ordered.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.isUnique
descriptions: For a multivalued multiplicity, this attributes specifies whether the values in an instantiation of this MultiplicityElement are unique.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.lower
descriptions: The lower bound of the multiplicity interval.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.lowerValue
descriptions: The specification of the lower bound for this multiplicity.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.upper
descriptions: The upper bound of the multiplicity interval.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement.upperValue
descriptions: The specification of the upper bound for this multiplicity.

definitions.name: MultiplicityElement
descriptions: A multiplicity is a definition of an inclusive interval of non-negative integers beginning with a lower bound and ending with a (possibly infinite) upper bound. A MultiplicityElement embeds this information to specify the allowable cardinalities for an instantiation of the Element.

definitions.name: NamedElement.allNamespaces
descriptions: The query allNamespaces() gives the sequence of Namespaces in which the NamedElement is nested, working outwards.

definitions.name: NamedElement.allOwningPackages
descriptions: The query allOwningPackages() returns the set of all the enclosing Namespaces of this NamedElement, working outwards, that are Packages, up to but not including the first such Namespace that is not a Package.

expressions.body:
result = (if namespace.oclIsKindOf(Package)
then
  let owningPackage : Package = namespace.oclAsType(Package) in
    owningPackage->union(owningPackage.allOwningPackages())
else
  null
endif)

definitions.limitation: A source null in the non-Package branch is normalized to the empty collection required by its signature.

definitions.name: NamedElement.isDistinguishableFrom
descriptions: The query isDistinguishableFrom() determines whether two NamedElements may logically co-exist within a Namespace. By default, two named elements are distinguishable if (a) they have types neither of which is a kind of the other or (b) they have different names.

definitions.name: NamedElement.qualifiedName
descriptions: When a NamedElement has a name, and all of its containing Namespaces have a name, the qualifiedName is constructed from the name of the NamedElement and the names of the containing Namespaces.

expressions.body:
result = (if self.name <> null and self.allNamespaces()->select( ns | ns.name=null )->isEmpty()
then 
    self.allNamespaces()->iterate( ns : Namespace; agg: String = self.name | ns.name.concat(self.separator()).concat(agg))
else
   null
endif)

definitions.limitation: The derived property is optional and the body returns null for unnamed elements.

definitions.name: NamedElement.separator
descriptions: The query separator() gives the string that is used to separate names when constructing a qualifiedName.

definitions.name: NamedElement.visibility_needs_ownership
descriptions: If a NamedElement is owned by something other than a Namespace, it does not have a visibility. One that is not owned by anything (and hence must be a Package, as this is the only kind of NamedElement that overrides mustBeOwned()) may have a visibility.

expressions.body: (namespace = null and owner <> null) implies visibility = null

definitions.name: NamedElement.has_qualified_name
descriptions: When there is a name, and all of the containing Namespaces have a name, the qualifiedName is constructed from the name of the NamedElement and the names of the containing Namespaces.

expressions.body:
(name <> null and allNamespaces()->select(ns | ns.name = null)->isEmpty()) implies
  qualifiedName = allNamespaces()->iterate( ns : Namespace; agg: String = name | ns.name.concat(self.separator()).concat(agg))

definitions.name: NamedElement.has_no_qualified_name
descriptions: If there is no name, or one of the containing Namespaces has no name, there is no qualifiedName.

expressions.body: name=null or allNamespaces()->select( ns | ns.name=null )->notEmpty() implies qualifiedName = null

definitions.name: NamedElement.clientDependency
descriptions: Indicates the Dependencies that reference this NamedElement as a client.

definitions.name: NamedElement.name
descriptions: The name of the NamedElement.

definitions.name: NamedElement.nameExpression
descriptions: The StringExpression used to define the name of this NamedElement.

definitions.name: NamedElement.namespace
descriptions: Specifies the Namespace that owns the NamedElement.

definitions.name: NamedElement.qualifiedName
descriptions: A name that allows the NamedElement to be identified within a hierarchy of nested Namespaces. It is constructed from the names of the containing Namespaces starting at the root of the hierarchy and ending with the name of the NamedElement itself.
definitions.limitation: The derived property is optional and the body returns null for unnamed elements.

definitions.name: NamedElement.visibility
descriptions: Determines whether and how the NamedElement is visible outside its owning Namespace.

definitions.name: NamedElement
descriptions: A NamedElement is an Element in a model that may have a name. The name may be given directly and/or via the use of a StringExpression.

definitions.name: Namespace.excludeCollisions
descriptions: The query excludeCollisions() excludes from a set of PackageableElements any that would not be distinguishable from each other in this Namespace.

definitions.name: Namespace.getNamesOfMember
descriptions: The query getNamesOfMember() gives a set of all of the names that a member would have in a Namespace, taking importing into account. In general a member can have multiple names in a Namespace if it is imported more than once with different aliases.

expressions.body:
result = (if self.ownedMember ->includes(element)
then Set{element.name}
else let elementImports : Set(ElementImport) = self.elementImport->select(ei | ei.importedElement = element) in
  if elementImports->notEmpty()
  then
     elementImports->collect(el | el.getName())->asSet()
  else 
     self.packageImport->select(pi | pi.importedPackage.visibleMembers().oclAsType(NamedElement)->includes(element))-> collect(pi | pi.importedPackage.getNamesOfMember(element))->asSet()
  endif
endif)

definitions.limitation: The body creates Set{element.name}, which can contain an undefined name.

definitions.name: Namespace.importMembers
descriptions: The query importMembers() defines which of a set of PackageableElements are actually imported into the Namespace. This excludes hidden ones, i.e., those which have names that conflict with names of ownedMembers, and it also excludes PackageableElements that would have the indistinguishable names when imported.

definitions.name: Namespace.importedMember
descriptions: The importedMember property is derived as the PackageableElements that are members of this Namespace as a result of either PackageImports or ElementImports.

definitions.name: Namespace.membersAreDistinguishable
descriptions: The Boolean query membersAreDistinguishable() determines whether all of the Namespace's members are distinguishable within it.

definitions.name: Namespace.members_distinguishable
descriptions: All the members of a Namespace are distinguishable within it.

definitions.name: Namespace.cannot_import_self
descriptions: A Namespace cannot have a PackageImport to itself.

definitions.name: Namespace.cannot_import_ownedMembers
descriptions: A Namespace cannot have an ElementImport to one of its ownedMembers.

definitions.name: Namespace.elementImport
descriptions: References the ElementImports owned by the Namespace.

definitions.name: Namespace.importedMember
descriptions: References the PackageableElements that are members of this Namespace as a result of either PackageImports or ElementImports.

definitions.name: Namespace.member
descriptions: A collection of NamedElements identifiable within the Namespace, either by being owned or by being introduced by importing or inheritance.

definitions.name: Namespace.ownedMember
descriptions: A collection of NamedElements owned by the Namespace.

definitions.name: Namespace.ownedRule
descriptions: Specifies a set of Constraints owned by this Namespace.

definitions.name: Namespace.packageImport
descriptions: References the PackageImports owned by the Namespace.

definitions.name: Namespace
descriptions: A Namespace is an Element in a model that owns and/or imports a set of NamedElements that can be identified by name.

definitions.name: PackageableElement.namespace_needs_visibility
descriptions: A PackageableElement owned by a Namespace must have a visibility.

definitions.name: PackageableElement.visibility
descriptions: A PackageableElement must have a visibility specified if it is owned by a Namespace. The default visibility is public.

definitions.name: PackageableElement
descriptions: A PackageableElement is a NamedElement that may be owned directly by a Package. A PackageableElement is also able to serve as the parameteredElement of a TemplateParameter.

definitions.name: PackageImport.public_or_private
descriptions: The visibility of a PackageImport is either public or private.

definitions.name: PackageImport.importedPackage
descriptions: Specifies the Package whose members are imported into a Namespace.

definitions.name: PackageImport.importingNamespace
descriptions: Specifies the Namespace that imports the members from a Package.

definitions.name: PackageImport.visibility
descriptions: Specifies the visibility of the imported PackageableElements within the importingNamespace, i.e., whether imported Elements will in turn be visible to other Namespaces. If the PackageImport is public, the imported Elements will be visible outside the importingNamespace, while, if the PackageImport is private, they will not.

definitions.name: PackageImport
descriptions: A PackageImport is a Relationship that imports all the non-private members of a Package into the Namespace owning the PackageImport, so that those Elements may be referred to by their unqualified names in the importingNamespace.

definitions.name: ParameterableElement.isCompatibleWith
descriptions: The query isCompatibleWith() determines if this ParameterableElement is compatible with the specified ParameterableElement. By default, this ParameterableElement is compatible with another ParameterableElement p if the kind of this ParameterableElement is the same as or a subtype of the kind of p. Subclasses of ParameterableElement should override this operation to specify different compatibility constraints.

definitions.name: ParameterableElement.isTemplateParameter
descriptions: The query isTemplateParameter() determines if this ParameterableElement is exposed as a formal TemplateParameter.

definitions.name: ParameterableElement.owningTemplateParameter
descriptions: The formal TemplateParameter that owns this ParameterableElement.

definitions.name: ParameterableElement.templateParameter
descriptions: The TemplateParameter that exposes this ParameterableElement as a formal parameter.

definitions.name: ParameterableElement
descriptions: A ParameterableElement is an Element that can be exposed as a formal TemplateParameter for a template, or specified as an actual parameter in a binding of a template.

definitions.name: Realization
descriptions: Realization is a specialized Abstraction relationship between two sets of model Elements, one representing a specification (the supplier) and the other represents an implementation of the latter (the client). Realization can be used to model stepwise refinement, optimizations, transformations, templates, model synthesis, framework composition, etc.

definitions.name: Relationship.relatedElement
descriptions: Specifies the elements related by the Relationship.

definitions.name: Relationship
descriptions: Relationship is an abstract concept that specifies some kind of relationship between Elements.

definitions.name: TemplateableElement.isTemplate
descriptions: The query isTemplate() returns whether this TemplateableElement is actually a template.

definitions.name: TemplateableElement.parameterableElements
descriptions: The query parameterableElements() returns the set of ParameterableElements that may be used as the parameteredElements for a TemplateParameter of this TemplateableElement. By default, this set includes all the ownedElements. Subclasses may override this operation if they choose to restrict the set of ParameterableElements.

definitions.name: TemplateableElement.ownedTemplateSignature
descriptions: The optional TemplateSignature specifying the formal TemplateParameters for this TemplateableElement. If a TemplateableElement has a TemplateSignature, then it is a template.

definitions.name: TemplateableElement.templateBinding
descriptions: The optional TemplateBindings from this TemplateableElement to one or more templates.

definitions.name: TemplateableElement
descriptions: A TemplateableElement is an Element that can optionally be defined as a template and bound to other templates.

definitions.name: TemplateBinding.parameter_substitution_formal
descriptions: Each parameterSubstitution must refer to a formal TemplateParameter of the target TemplateSignature.

definitions.name: TemplateBinding.one_parameter_substitution
descriptions: A TemplateBiinding contains at most one TemplateParameterSubstitution for each formal TemplateParameter of the target TemplateSignature.

definitions.name: TemplateBinding.boundElement
descriptions: The TemplateableElement that is bound by this TemplateBinding.

definitions.name: TemplateBinding.parameterSubstitution
descriptions: The TemplateParameterSubstitutions owned by this TemplateBinding.

definitions.name: TemplateBinding.signature
descriptions: The TemplateSignature for the template that is the target of this TemplateBinding.

definitions.name: TemplateBinding
descriptions: A TemplateBinding is a DirectedRelationship between a TemplateableElement and a template. A TemplateBinding specifies the TemplateParameterSubstitutions of actual parameters for the formal parameters of the template.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter.must_be_compatible
descriptions: The default must be compatible with the formal TemplateParameter.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter.default
descriptions: The ParameterableElement that is the default for this formal TemplateParameter.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter.ownedDefault
descriptions: The ParameterableElement that is owned by this TemplateParameter for the purpose of providing a default.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter.ownedParameteredElement
descriptions: The ParameterableElement that is owned by this TemplateParameter for the purpose of exposing it as the parameteredElement.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter.parameteredElement
descriptions: The ParameterableElement exposed by this TemplateParameter.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter.signature
descriptions: The TemplateSignature that owns this TemplateParameter.

definitions.name: TemplateParameter
descriptions: A TemplateParameter exposes a ParameterableElement as a formal parameter of a template.

definitions.name: TemplateParameterSubstitution.must_be_compatible
descriptions: The actual ParameterableElement must be compatible with the formal TemplateParameter, e.g., the actual ParameterableElement for a Class TemplateParameter must be a Class.

definitions.name: TemplateParameterSubstitution.actual
descriptions: The ParameterableElement that is the actual parameter for this TemplateParameterSubstitution.

definitions.name: TemplateParameterSubstitution.formal
descriptions: The formal TemplateParameter that is associated with this TemplateParameterSubstitution.

definitions.name: TemplateParameterSubstitution.ownedActual
descriptions: The ParameterableElement that is owned by this TemplateParameterSubstitution as its actual parameter.

definitions.name: TemplateParameterSubstitution.templateBinding
descriptions: The TemplateBinding that owns this TemplateParameterSubstitution.

definitions.name: TemplateParameterSubstitution
descriptions: A TemplateParameterSubstitution relates the actual parameter to a formal TemplateParameter as part of a template binding.

definitions.name: TemplateSignature.own_elements
descriptions: Parameters must own the ParameterableElements they parameter or those ParameterableElements must be owned by the TemplateableElement being templated.

definitions.name: TemplateSignature.unique_parameters
descriptions: The names of the parameters of a TemplateSignature are unique.

expressions.body:
parameter->forAll( p1, p2 | (p1 <> p2 and p1.parameteredElement.oclIsKindOf(NamedElement) and p2.parameteredElement.oclIsKindOf(NamedElement) ) implies
   p1.parameteredElement.oclAsType(NamedElement).name <> p2.parameteredElement.oclAsType(NamedElement).name)

definitions.name: TemplateSignature.ownedParameter
descriptions: The formal parameters that are owned by this TemplateSignature.

definitions.name: TemplateSignature.parameter
descriptions: The ordered set of all formal TemplateParameters for this TemplateSignature.

definitions.name: TemplateSignature.template
descriptions: The TemplateableElement that owns this TemplateSignature.

definitions.name: TemplateSignature
descriptions: A Template Signature bundles the set of formal TemplateParameters for a template.

definitions.name: Type.conformsTo
descriptions: The query conformsTo() gives true for a Type that conforms to another. By default, two Types do not conform to each other. This query is intended to be redefined for specific conformance situations.

definitions.name: Type.package
descriptions: Specifies the owning Package of this Type, if any.

definitions.name: Type
descriptions: A Type constrains the values represented by a TypedElement.

definitions.name: TypedElement.type
descriptions: The type of the TypedElement.

definitions.name: TypedElement
descriptions: A TypedElement is a NamedElement that may have a Type specified for it.

definitions.name: Usage
descriptions: A Usage is a Dependency in which the client Element requires the supplier Element (or set of Elements) for its full implementation or operation.

definitions.name: AnyReceiveEvent
descriptions: A trigger for an AnyReceiveEvent is triggered by the receipt of any message that is not explicitly handled by any related trigger.

definitions.name: Behavior.context
descriptions: A Behavior that is directly owned as a nestedClassifier does not have a context. Otherwise, to determine the context of a Behavior, find the first BehavioredClassifier reached by following the chain of owner relationships from the Behavior, if any. If there is such a BehavioredClassifier, then it is the context, unless it is itself a Behavior with a non-empty context, in which case that is also the context for the original Behavior.

expressions.body:
result = (if nestingClass <> null then
    null
else
    let b:BehavioredClassifier = self.behavioredClassifier(self.owner) in
    if b.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) and b.oclAsType(Behavior)._'context' <> null then 
        b.oclAsType(Behavior)._'context'
    else 
        b 
    endif
endif
        )

definitions.name: Behavior.behavioredClassifier
descriptions: The first BehavioredClassifier reached by following the chain of owner relationships from the Behavior, if any.

expressions.body:
if from.oclIsKindOf(BehavioredClassifier) then
    from.oclAsType(BehavioredClassifier)
else if from.owner = null then
    null
else
    self.behavioredClassifier(from.owner)
endif
endif

definitions.name: Behavior.behavioredClassifier.precondition

expressions.body:
if from.oclIsKindOf(BehavioredClassifier) then
    from.oclAsType(BehavioredClassifier)
else if from.owner = null then
    null
else
    self.behavioredClassifier(from.owner)
endif
endif

definitions.limitation: The precondition references the classifier-finding body rather than a Boolean predicate. Python implements the finder and its argument contract; the malformed precondition is not treated as a Boolean proof.

definitions.name: Behavior.inputParameters
descriptions: The in and inout ownedParameters of the Behavior.

definitions.name: Behavior.outputParameters
descriptions: The out, inout and return ownedParameters.

definitions.name: Behavior.most_one_behavior
descriptions: There may be at most one Behavior for a given pairing of BehavioredClassifier (as owner of the Behavior) and BehavioralFeature (as specification of the Behavior).

definitions.name: Behavior.parameters_match
descriptions: If a Behavior has a specification BehavioralFeature, then it must have the same number of ownedParameters as its specification. The Behavior Parameters must also "match" the BehavioralParameter Parameters, but the exact requirements for this matching are not formalized.

definitions.name: Behavior.feature_of_context_classifier
descriptions: The specification BehavioralFeature must be a feature (possibly inherited) of the context BehavioredClassifier of the Behavior.
definitions.limitation: The unguarded formula rejects absent specifications although the reference is optional. Python checks context membership only for specified methods.

definitions.name: Behavior.context
descriptions: The BehavioredClassifier that is the context for the execution of the Behavior. A Behavior that is directly owned as a nestedClassifier does not have a context. Otherwise, to determine the context of a Behavior, find the first BehavioredClassifier reached by following the chain of owner relationships from the Behavior, if any. If there is such a BehavioredClassifier, then it is the context, unless it is itself a Behavior with a non-empty context, in which case that is also the context for the original Behavior. For example, following this algorithm, the context of an entry Behavior in a StateMachine is the BehavioredClassifier that owns the StateMachine. The features of the context BehavioredClassifier as well as the Elements visible to the context Classifier are visible to the Behavior.

definitions.name: Behavior.isReentrant
descriptions: Tells whether the Behavior can be invoked while it is still executing from a previous invocation.

definitions.name: Behavior.ownedParameter
descriptions: References a list of Parameters to the Behavior which describes the order and type of arguments that can be given when the Behavior is invoked and of the values which will be returned when the Behavior completes its execution.

definitions.name: Behavior.ownedParameterSet
descriptions: The ParameterSets owned by this Behavior.

definitions.name: Behavior.postcondition
descriptions: An optional set of Constraints specifying what is fulfilled after the execution of the Behavior is completed, if its precondition was fulfilled before its invocation.

definitions.name: Behavior.precondition
descriptions: An optional set of Constraints specifying what must be fulfilled before the Behavior is invoked.

definitions.name: Behavior.specification
descriptions: Designates a BehavioralFeature that the Behavior implements. The BehavioralFeature must be owned by the BehavioredClassifier that owns the Behavior or be inherited by it. The Parameters of the BehavioralFeature and the implementing Behavior must match. A Behavior does not need to have a specification, in which case it either is the classifierBehavior of a BehavioredClassifier or it can only be invoked by another Behavior of the Classifier.

definitions.name: Behavior.redefinedBehavior
descriptions: References the Behavior that this Behavior redefines. A subtype of Behavior may redefine any other subtype of Behavior. If the Behavior implements a BehavioralFeature, it replaces the redefined Behavior. If the Behavior is a classifierBehavior, it extends the redefined Behavior.

definitions.name: Behavior
descriptions: Behavior is a specification of how its context BehavioredClassifier changes state over time. This specification may be either a definition of possible behavior execution or emergent behavior, or a selective illustration of an interesting subset of possible executions. The latter form is typically used for capturing examples, such as a trace of a particular execution.

definitions.name: CallEvent.operation
descriptions: Designates the Operation whose invocation raised the CalEvent.

definitions.name: CallEvent
descriptions: A CallEvent models the receipt by an object of a message invoking a call of an Operation.

definitions.name: ChangeEvent.changeExpression
descriptions: A Boolean-valued ValueSpecification that will result in a ChangeEvent whenever its value changes from false to true.

definitions.name: ChangeEvent
descriptions: A ChangeEvent models a change in the system configuration that makes a condition true.

definitions.name: Event
descriptions: An Event is the specification of some occurrence that may potentially trigger effects by an object.

definitions.name: FunctionBehavior.hasAllDataTypeAttributes
descriptions: The hasAllDataTypeAttributes query tests whether the types of the attributes of the given DataType are all DataTypes, and similarly for all those DataTypes.

definitions.name: FunctionBehavior.one_output_parameter
descriptions: A FunctionBehavior has at least one output Parameter.

expressions.body:
self.ownedParameter->
  select(p | p.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::out or p.direction= ParameterDirectionKind::inout or p.direction= ParameterDirectionKind::return)->size() >= 1

definitions.name: FunctionBehavior.types_of_parameters
descriptions: The types of the ownedParameters are all DataTypes, which may not nest anything but other DataTypes.

expressions.body:
ownedParameter->forAll(p | p.type <> null and
  p.type.oclIsTypeOf(DataType) and hasAllDataTypeAttributes(p.type.oclAsType(DataType)))

definitions.limitation: The source requires exact DataType parameters, excluding PrimitiveType/Enumeration despite broader DataType wording. Python preserves isTypeOf; nested attributes use isKindOf as declared.

definitions.name: FunctionBehavior
descriptions: A FunctionBehavior is an OpaqueBehavior that does not access or modify any objects or other external data.

definitions.name: MessageEvent
descriptions: A MessageEvent specifies the receipt by an object of either an Operation call or a Signal instance.

definitions.name: OpaqueBehavior.body
descriptions: Specifies the behavior in one or more languages.

definitions.name: OpaqueBehavior.language
descriptions: Languages the body strings use in the same order as the body strings.

definitions.name: OpaqueBehavior
descriptions: An OpaqueBehavior is a Behavior whose specification is given in a textual language other than UML.

definitions.name: SignalEvent.signal
descriptions: The specific Signal that is associated with this SignalEvent.

definitions.name: SignalEvent
descriptions: A SignalEvent represents the receipt of an asynchronous Signal instance.

definitions.name: TimeEvent.when_non_negative
descriptions: The ValueSpecification when must return a non-negative Integer.
definitions.limitation: TimeExpression has no integerValue override in the XMI. Python checks represented computable expr values; foreign expressions/observations require numeric evaluation evidence and remain unsupported. No clock or scheduler is executed.

definitions.name: TimeEvent.isRelative
descriptions: Specifies whether the TimeEvent is specified as an absolute or relative time.

definitions.name: TimeEvent.when
descriptions: Specifies the time of the TimeEvent.

definitions.name: TimeEvent
descriptions: A TimeEvent is an Event that occurs at a specific point in time.

definitions.name: Trigger.trigger_with_ports
descriptions: If a Trigger specifies one or more ports, the event of the Trigger must be a MessageEvent.

definitions.name: Trigger.event
descriptions: The Event that detected by the Trigger.

definitions.name: Trigger.port
descriptions: A optional Port of through which the given effect is detected.

definitions.name: Trigger
descriptions: A Trigger specifies a specific point  at which an Event occurrence may trigger an effect in a Behavior. A Trigger may be qualified by the Port on which the Event occurred.

definitions.name: Substitution.contract
descriptions: The contract with which the substituting classifier complies.

definitions.name: Substitution.substitutingClassifier
descriptions: Instances of the substituting classifier are runtime substitutable where instances of the contract classifier are expected.

definitions.name: Substitution
descriptions: A substitution is a relationship between two classifiers signifying that the substituting classifier complies with the contract specified by the contract classifier. This implies that instances of the substituting classifier are runtime substitutable where instances of the contract classifier are expected.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.isDistinguishableFrom
descriptions: The query isDistinguishableFrom() determines whether two BehavioralFeatures may coexist in the same Namespace. It specifies that they must have different signatures.

expressions.body:
result = ((n.oclIsKindOf(BehavioralFeature) and ns.getNamesOfMember(self)->intersection(ns.getNamesOfMember(n))->notEmpty()) implies
  Set{self}->including(n.oclAsType(BehavioralFeature))->isUnique(ownedParameter->collect(p|
  Tuple { name=p.name, type=p.type,effect=p.effect,direction=p.direction,isException=p.isException,
              isStream=p.isStream,isOrdered=p.isOrdered,isUnique=p.isUnique,lower=p.lower, upper=p.upper }))
  )

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.inputParameters
descriptions: The ownedParameters with direction in and inout.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.outputParameters
descriptions: The ownedParameters with direction out, inout, or return.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.abstract_no_method
descriptions: When isAbstract is true there are no methods.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.concurrency
descriptions: Specifies the semantics of concurrent calls to the same passive instance (i.e., an instance originating from a Class with isActive being false). Active instances control access to their own BehavioralFeatures.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.isAbstract
descriptions: If true, then the BehavioralFeature does not have an implementation, and one must be supplied by a more specific Classifier. If false, the BehavioralFeature must have an implementation in the Classifier or one must be inherited.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.method
descriptions: A Behavior that implements the BehavioralFeature. There may be at most one Behavior for a particular pairing of a Classifier (as owner of the Behavior) and a BehavioralFeature (as specification of the Behavior).

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.ownedParameter
descriptions: The ordered set of formal Parameters of this BehavioralFeature.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.ownedParameterSet
descriptions: The ParameterSets owned by this BehavioralFeature.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature.raisedException
descriptions: The Types representing exceptions that may be raised during an invocation of this BehavioralFeature.

definitions.name: BehavioralFeature
descriptions: A BehavioralFeature is a feature of a Classifier that specifies an aspect of the behavior of its instances.  A BehavioralFeature is implemented (realized) by a Behavior. A BehavioralFeature specifies that a Classifier will respond to a designated request by invoking its implementing method.

definitions.name: Classifier.allFeatures
descriptions: The query allFeatures() gives all of the Features in the namespace of the Classifier. In general, through mechanisms such as inheritance, this will be a larger set than feature.

definitions.name: Classifier.allParents
descriptions: The query allParents() gives all of the direct and indirect ancestors of a generalized Classifier.

definitions.name: Classifier.conformsTo
descriptions: The query conformsTo() gives true for a Classifier that defines a type that conforms to another. This is used, for example, in the specification of signature conformance for operations.

expressions.body:
result = (if other.oclIsKindOf(Classifier) then
  let otherClassifier : Classifier = other.oclAsType(Classifier) in
    self = otherClassifier or allParents()->includes(otherClassifier)
else
  false
endif)

definitions.name: Classifier.general
descriptions: The general Classifiers are the ones referenced by the Generalization relationships.

definitions.name: Classifier.hasVisibilityOf
descriptions: The query hasVisibilityOf() determines whether a NamedElement is visible in the classifier. Non-private members are visible. It is only called when the argument is something owned by a parent.

definitions.name: Classifier.inherit
descriptions: The query inherit() defines how to inherit a set of elements passed as its argument.  It excludes redefined elements from the result.

definitions.name: Classifier.inheritableMembers
descriptions: The query inheritableMembers() gives all of the members of a Classifier that may be inherited in one of its descendants, subject to whatever visibility restrictions apply.

definitions.name: Classifier.inheritedMember
descriptions: The inheritedMember association is derived by inheriting the inheritable members of the parents.

definitions.name: Classifier.isTemplate
descriptions: The query isTemplate() returns whether this Classifier is actually a template.

definitions.name: Classifier.maySpecializeType

descriptions: The query allAttributes gives an ordered set of all owned and inherited attributes of the Classifier. All owned attributes appear before any inherited attributes, and the attributes inherited from any more specific parent Classifier appear before those of any more general parent Classifier. However, if the Classifier has multiple immediate parents, then the relative ordering of the sets of attributes from those parents is not defined.

definitions.name: Classifier.allSlottableFeatures
descriptions: All StructuralFeatures related to the Classifier that may have Slots, including direct attributes, inherited attributes, private attributes in generalizations, and memberEnds of Associations, but excluding redefined StructuralFeatures.

definitions.name: Classifier.specialize_type

descriptions: The Classifier that maps to a GeneralizationSet may neither be a specific nor a general Classifier in any of the Generalization relationships defined for that GeneralizationSet. In other words, a power type may not be an instance of itself nor may its instances also be its subclasses.

powertypeExtent->forAll( gs | 
  gs.generalization->forAll( gen | 
    not (gen.general = self) and not gen.general.allParents()->includes(self) and not (gen.specific = self) and not self.allParents()->includes(gen.specific)

definitions.name: Classifier.attribute

definitions.name: Classifier.collaborationUse

definitions.name: Classifier.inheritedMember

definitions.name: Classifier.isFinalSpecialization
descriptions: If true, the Classifier cannot be specialized.

definitions.name: Classifier.redefinedClassifier
descriptions: The Classifiers redefined by this Classifier.

definitions.name: Classifier.representation

definitions.name: Classifier.substitution

definitions.name: Classifier.useCase
descriptions: The set of UseCases for which this Classifier is the subject.

definitions.name: Classifier
descriptions: A Classifier represents a classification of instances according to their Features.

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter.actual_is_classifier

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter.constraining_classifiers_constrain_args
descriptions: If there are any constrainingClassifiers, then every argument must be the same as or a specialization of them, or if allowSubstitutable is true, then it can also be substitutable.

expressions.body:
templateParameterSubstitution.actual->forAll( a |
  let arg : Classifier = a.oclAsType(Classifier) in
    constrainingClassifier->forAll(
      cc |  
         arg = cc or arg.conformsTo(cc) or (allowSubstitutable and arg.isSubstitutableFor(cc))

)

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter.constraining_classifiers_constrain_parametered_element
descriptions: If there are any constrainingClassifiers, then the parameteredElement must be the same as or a specialization of them, or if allowSubstitutable is true, then it can also be substitutable.

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter.allowSubstitutable
descriptions: Constrains the required relationship between an actual parameter and the parameteredElement for this formal parameter.

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter.constrainingClassifier
descriptions: The classifiers that constrain the argument that can be used for the parameter. If the allowSubstitutable attribute is true, then any Classifier that is compatible with this constraining Classifier can be substituted; otherwise, it must be either this Classifier or one of its specializations. If this property is empty, there are no constraints on the Classifier that can be used as an argument.

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter.parameteredElement
descriptions: The Classifier exposed by this ClassifierTemplateParameter.

definitions.name: ClassifierTemplateParameter
descriptions: A ClassifierTemplateParameter exposes a Classifier as a formal template parameter.

definitions.name: Feature.featuringClassifier

definitions.name: Feature
descriptions: A Feature declares a behavioral or structural characteristic of Classifiers.

definitions.name: Generalization.general
descriptions: The general classifier in the Generalization relationship.

definitions.name: Generalization.generalizationSet
descriptions: Represents a set of instances of Generalization.  A Generalization may appear in many GeneralizationSets.

definitions.name: Generalization.isSubstitutable
descriptions: Indicates whether the specific Classifier can be used wherever the general Classifier can be used. If true, the execution traces of the specific Classifier shall be a superset of the execution traces of the general Classifier. If false, there is no such constraint on execution traces. If unset, the modeler has not stated whether there is such a constraint or not.

definitions.name: Generalization.specific
descriptions: The specializing Classifier in the Generalization relationship.

definitions.name: Generalization
descriptions: A Generalization is a taxonomic relationship between a more general Classifier and a more specific Classifier. Each instance of the specific Classifier is also an instance of the general Classifier. The specific Classifier inherits the features of the more general Classifier. A Generalization is owned by the specific Classifier.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet.generalization_same_classifier
descriptions: Every Generalization associated with a particular GeneralizationSet must have the same general Classifier.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet.maps_to_generalization_set
descriptions: The Classifier that maps to a GeneralizationSet may neither be a specific nor a general Classifier in any of the Generalization relationships defined for that GeneralizationSet. In other words, a power type may not be an instance of itself nor may its instances be its subclasses.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet.generalization
descriptions: Designates the instances of Generalization that are members of this GeneralizationSet.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet.isCovering
descriptions: Indicates (via the associated Generalizations) whether or not the set of specific Classifiers are covering for a particular general classifier. When isCovering is true, every instance of a particular general Classifier is also an instance of at least one of its specific Classifiers for the GeneralizationSet. When isCovering is false, there are one or more instances of the particular general Classifier that are not instances of at least one of its specific Classifiers defined for the GeneralizationSet.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet.isDisjoint
descriptions: Indicates whether or not the set of specific Classifiers in a Generalization relationship have instance in common. If isDisjoint is true, the specific Classifiers for a particular GeneralizationSet have no members in common; that is, their intersection is empty. If isDisjoint is false, the specific Classifiers in a particular GeneralizationSet have one or more members in common; that is, their intersection is not empty.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet.powertype
descriptions: Designates the Classifier that is defined as the power type for the associated GeneralizationSet, if there is one.

definitions.name: GeneralizationSet
descriptions: A GeneralizationSet is a PackageableElement whose instances represent sets of Generalization relationships.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.deployment_artifact
descriptions: An InstanceSpecification can act as a DeployedArtifact if it represents an instance of an Artifact.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.structural_feature
descriptions: No more than one slot in an InstanceSpecification may have the same definingFeature.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.defining_feature
descriptions: The definingFeature of each slot is a StructuralFeature related to a classifier of the InstanceSpecification, including direct attributes, inherited attributes, private attributes in generalizations, and memberEnds of Associations, but excluding redefined StructuralFeatures.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.deployment_target
descriptions: An InstanceSpecification can act as a DeploymentTarget if it represents an instance of a Node and functions as a part in the internal structure of an encompassing Node.

expressions.body: deployment->notEmpty() implies classifier->exists(node | node.oclIsKindOf(Node) and Node.allInstances()->exists(n | n.part->exists(p | p.type = node)))

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.classifier
descriptions: The Classifier or Classifiers of the represented instance. If multiple Classifiers are specified, the instance is classified by all of them.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.slot
descriptions: A Slot giving the value or values of a StructuralFeature of the instance. An InstanceSpecification can have one Slot per StructuralFeature of its Classifiers, including inherited features. It is not necessary to model a Slot for every StructuralFeature, in which case the InstanceSpecification is a partial description.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification.specification
descriptions: A specification of how to compute, derive, or construct the instance.

definitions.name: InstanceSpecification
descriptions: An InstanceSpecification is a model element that represents an instance in a modeled system. An InstanceSpecification can act as a DeploymentTarget in a Deployment relationship, in the case that it represents an instance of a Node. It can also act as a DeployedArtifact, if it represents an instance of an Artifact.

definitions.name: InstanceValue.instance
descriptions: The InstanceSpecification that represents the specified value.

definitions.name: InstanceValue
descriptions: An InstanceValue is a ValueSpecification that identifies an instance.

definitions.name: Operation.isConsistentWith
descriptions:
The query isConsistentWith() specifies, for any two Operations in a context in which redefinition is possible, whether redefinition would be consistent. A redefining operation is consistent with a redefined operation if
it has the same number of owned parameters, and for each parameter the following holds:

- Direction, ordering and uniqueness are the same.
- The corresponding types are covariant, contravariant or invariant.
- The multiplicities are compatible, depending on the parameter direction.

expressions.body:
result = (redefiningElement.oclIsKindOf(Operation) and
let op : Operation = redefiningElement.oclAsType(Operation) in
	self.ownedParameter->size() = op.ownedParameter->size() and
	Sequence{1..self.ownedParameter->size()}->
		forAll(i |  
		  let redefiningParam : Parameter = op.ownedParameter->at(i),
               redefinedParam : Parameter = self.ownedParameter->at(i) in
                 (redefiningParam.isUnique = redefinedParam.isUnique) and
                 (redefiningParam.isOrdered = redefinedParam. isOrdered) and
                 (redefiningParam.direction = redefinedParam.direction) and
                 (redefiningParam.type.conformsTo(redefinedParam.type) or
                     redefinedParam.type.conformsTo(redefiningParam.type)) and
                 (redefiningParam.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::inout implies
                         (redefinedParam.compatibleWith(redefiningParam) and
                         redefiningParam.compatibleWith(redefinedParam))) and
                 (redefiningParam.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::_'in' implies
                         redefinedParam.compatibleWith(redefiningParam)) and
                 ((redefiningParam.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::out or
                      redefiningParam.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::return) implies
                         redefiningParam.compatibleWith(redefinedParam))
		))

definitions.name: Operation.isOrdered
descriptions: If this operation has a return parameter, isOrdered equals the value of isOrdered for that parameter. Otherwise isOrdered is false.

expressions.body: result = (if returnResult()->notEmpty() then returnResult()-> exists(isOrdered) else false endif)

definitions.name: Operation.isUnique
descriptions: If this operation has a return parameter, isUnique equals the value of isUnique for that parameter. Otherwise isUnique is true.

expressions.body: result = (if returnResult()->notEmpty() then returnResult()->exists(isUnique) else true endif)

definitions.name: Operation.lower
descriptions: If this operation has a return parameter, lower equals the value of lower for that parameter. Otherwise lower has no value.

expressions.body: result = (if returnResult()->notEmpty() then returnResult()->any(true).lower else null endif)

definitions.limitation: The property is optional and the query returns null without a return parameter.

definitions.name: Operation.returnResult
descriptions: The query returnResult() returns the set containing the return parameter of the Operation if one exists, otherwise, it returns an empty set

definitions.name: Operation.type
descriptions: If this operation has a return parameter, type equals the value of type for that parameter. Otherwise type has no value.

expressions.body: result = (if returnResult()->notEmpty() then returnResult()->any(true).type else null endif)

definitions.limitation: The property is optional and the query returns null without a return parameter or its type.

definitions.name: Operation.upper
descriptions: If this operation has a return parameter, upper equals the value of upper for that parameter. Otherwise upper has no value.

expressions.body: result = (if returnResult()->notEmpty() then returnResult()->any(true).upper else null endif)

definitions.limitation: The property is optional and the query returns null without a return parameter.

definitions.name: Operation.at_most_one_return
descriptions: An Operation can have at most one return parameter; i.e., an owned parameter with the direction set to 'return.'

definitions.name: Operation.only_body_for_query
descriptions: A bodyCondition can only be specified for a query Operation.

definitions.name: Operation.bodyCondition
descriptions: An optional Constraint on the result values of an invocation of this Operation.

definitions.name: Operation.datatype

definitions.name: Operation.interface

definitions.name: Operation.isOrdered
descriptions: Specifies whether the return parameter is ordered or not, if present.  This information is derived from the return result for this Operation.

definitions.name: Operation.isQuery
descriptions: Specifies whether an execution of the BehavioralFeature leaves the state of the system unchanged (isQuery=true) or whether side effects may occur (isQuery=false).

definitions.name: Operation.isUnique
descriptions: Specifies whether the return parameter is unique or not, if present. This information is derived from the return result for this Operation.

definitions.name: Operation.lower
descriptions: Specifies the lower multiplicity of the return parameter, if present. This information is derived from the return result for this Operation.

definitions.name: Operation.ownedParameter
descriptions: The parameters owned by this Operation.

descriptions: An optional set of Constraints specifying the state of the system when the Operation is completed.

definitions.name: Operation.precondition
descriptions: An optional set of Constraints on the state of the system when the Operation is invoked.

definitions.name: Operation.raisedException
descriptions: The Types representing exceptions that may be raised during an invocation of this operation.

definitions.name: Operation.redefinedOperation
descriptions: The Operations that are redefined by this Operation.

definitions.name: Operation.templateParameter
descriptions: The OperationTemplateParameter that exposes this element as a formal parameter.

definitions.name: Operation.type
descriptions: The return type of the operation, if present. This information is derived from the return result for this Operation.
definitions.limitation: The property is optional and the query returns null without a return parameter or its type.

definitions.name: Operation.upper
descriptions: The upper multiplicity of the return parameter, if present. This information is derived from the return result for this Operation.

definitions.name: Operation
descriptions: An Operation is a BehavioralFeature of a Classifier that specifies the name, type, parameters, and constraints for invoking an associated Behavior. An Operation may invoke both the execution of method behaviors as well as other behavioral responses. Operation specializes TemplateableElement in order to support specification of template operations and bound operations. Operation specializes ParameterableElement to specify that an operation can be exposed as a formal template parameter, and provided as an actual parameter in a binding of a template.

expressions.body:
default->notEmpty() implies (default.oclIsKindOf(Operation) and (let defaultOp : Operation = default.oclAsType(Operation) in 
    defaultOp.ownedParameter->size() = parameteredElement.ownedParameter->size() and
    Sequence{1.. defaultOp.ownedParameter->size()}->forAll( ix | 
        let p1: Parameter = defaultOp.ownedParameter->at(ix), p2 : Parameter = parameteredElement.ownedParameter->at(ix) in
          p1.type = p2.type and p1.upper = p2.upper and p1.lower = p2.lower and p1.direction = p2.direction and p1.isOrdered = p2.isOrdered and p1.isUnique = p2.isUnique)))

definitions.name: OperationTemplateParameter.parameteredElement
descriptions: The Operation exposed by this OperationTemplateParameter.

definitions.name: OperationTemplateParameter
descriptions: An OperationTemplateParameter exposes an Operation as a formal parameter for a template.

definitions.name: Parameter.default
descriptions: Derivation for Parameter::/default

expressions.body: result = (if self.type = String then defaultValue.stringValue() else null endif)

definitions.name: Parameter.in_and_out
descriptions: Only in and inout Parameters may have a delete effect. Only out, inout, and return Parameters may have a create effect.

expressions.body:
(effect = ParameterEffectKind::delete implies (direction = ParameterDirectionKind::_'in' or direction = ParameterDirectionKind::inout))
and
(effect = ParameterEffectKind::create implies (direction = ParameterDirectionKind::out or direction = ParameterDirectionKind::inout or direction = ParameterDirectionKind::return))

definitions.name: Parameter.not_exception
descriptions: An input Parameter cannot be an exception.

expressions.body: isException implies (direction <> ParameterDirectionKind::_'in' and direction <> ParameterDirectionKind::inout)

definitions.name: Parameter.connector_end
descriptions: A Parameter may only be associated with a Connector end within the context of a Collaboration.

definitions.name: Parameter.reentrant_behaviors
descriptions: Reentrant behaviors cannot have stream Parameters.

expressions.body: (isStream and behavior <> null) implies not behavior.isReentrant

definitions.name: Parameter.stream_and_exception
descriptions: A Parameter cannot be a stream and exception at the same time.

definitions.name: Parameter.object_effect
descriptions: Parameters typed by DataTypes cannot have an effect.

definitions.name: Parameter.default
descriptions: A String that represents a value to be used when no argument is supplied for the Parameter.

definitions.name: Parameter.defaultValue
descriptions: Specifies a ValueSpecification that represents a value to be used when no argument is supplied for the Parameter.

definitions.name: Parameter.direction
descriptions: Indicates whether a parameter is being sent into or out of a behavioral element.

definitions.name: Parameter.effect
descriptions: Specifies the effect that executions of the owner of the Parameter have on objects passed in or out of the parameter.

definitions.name: Parameter.isException
descriptions: Tells whether an output parameter may emit a value to the exclusion of the other outputs.

definitions.name: Parameter.isStream
descriptions: Tells whether an input parameter may accept values while its behavior is executing, or whether an output parameter may post values while the behavior is executing.

definitions.name: Parameter.operation
descriptions: The Operation owning this parameter.

definitions.name: Parameter.parameterSet
descriptions: The ParameterSets containing the parameter. See ParameterSet.

definitions.name: Parameter
descriptions: A Parameter is a specification of an argument used to pass information into or out of an invocation of a BehavioralFeature.  Parameters can be treated as ConnectableElements within Collaborations.

definitions.name: ParameterSet.same_parameterized_entity
descriptions: The Parameters in a ParameterSet must all be inputs or all be outputs of the same parameterized entity, and the ParameterSet is owned by that entity.

expressions.body: parameter->forAll(p1, p2 | self.owner = p1.owner and self.owner = p2.owner and p1.direction = p2.direction)

definitions.name: ParameterSet.input
descriptions: If a parameterized entity has input Parameters that are in a ParameterSet, then any inputs that are not in a ParameterSet must be streaming. Same for output Parameters.

expressions.body:
((parameter->exists(direction = ParameterDirectionKind::_'in')) implies 
    behavioralFeature.ownedParameter->select(p | p.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::_'in' and p.parameterSet->isEmpty())->forAll(isStream))
    and
((parameter->exists(direction = ParameterDirectionKind::out)) implies 
    behavioralFeature.ownedParameter->select(p | p.direction = ParameterDirectionKind::out and p.parameterSet->isEmpty())->forAll(isStream))

definitions.name: ParameterSet.two_parameter_sets
descriptions: Two ParameterSets cannot have exactly the same set of Parameters.

expressions.body: parameter->forAll(parameterSet->forAll(s1, s2 | s1->size() = s2->size() implies s1.parameter->exists(p | not s2.parameter->includes(p))))

definitions.limitation: The formula compares every pair including a set to itself and uses size on the object. Python compares distinct sets and their parameter memberships according to the description.

definitions.name: ParameterSet.condition
descriptions: A constraint that should be satisfied for the owner of the Parameters in an input ParameterSet to start execution using the values provided for those Parameters, or the owner of the Parameters in an output ParameterSet to end execution providing the values for those Parameters, if all preconditions and conditions on input ParameterSets were satisfied.

definitions.name: ParameterSet.parameter
descriptions: Parameters in the ParameterSet.

definitions.name: ParameterSet
descriptions: A ParameterSet designates alternative sets of inputs or outputs that a Behavior may use.

definitions.name: Property.isAttribute
descriptions: The query isAttribute() is true if the Property is defined as an attribute of some Classifier.

definitions.name: Property.isCompatibleWith
descriptions: The query isCompatibleWith() determines if this Property is compatible with the specified ParameterableElement. This Property is compatible with ParameterableElement p if the kind of this Property is thesame as or a subtype of the kind of p. Further, if p is a TypedElement, then the type of this Property must be conformant with the type of p.
definitions.limitation: The source refers to the nonexistent TypeElement; Python uses TypedElement.

definitions.name: Property.isComposite
descriptions: The value of isComposite is true only if aggregation is composite.

definitions.name: Property.isConsistentWith
descriptions: The query isConsistentWith() specifies, for any two Properties in a context in which redefinition is possible, whether redefinition would be logically consistent. A redefining Property is consistent with a redefined Property if the type of the redefining Property conforms to the type of the redefined Property, and the multiplicity of the redefining Property (if specified) is contained in the multiplicity of the redefined Property.

expressions.body:
result = (redefiningElement.oclIsKindOf(Property) and 
  let prop : Property = redefiningElement.oclAsType(Property) in 
  (prop.type.conformsTo(self.type) and 
  ((prop.lowerBound()->notEmpty() and self.lowerBound()->notEmpty()) implies prop.lowerBound() >= self.lowerBound()) and 
  ((prop.upperBound()->notEmpty() and self.upperBound()->notEmpty()) implies prop.lowerBound() <= self.lowerBound()) and 
  (self.isComposite implies prop.isComposite)))

definitions.limitation: The source upper-bound clause repeats lowerBound; Python uses upperBound according to the description.

definitions.name: Property.isNavigable
descriptions: The query isNavigable() indicates whether it is possible to navigate across the property.

definitions.name: Property.opposite
descriptions: If this property is a memberEnd of a binary association, then opposite gives the other end.

expressions.body:
result = (if association <> null and association.memberEnd->size() = 2
then
    association.memberEnd->any(e | e <> self)
else
    null
endif)

definitions.limitation: The property is optional and the query returns null for a non-binary or absent association.

definitions.name: Property.subsettingContext
descriptions: The query subsettingContext() gives the context for subsetting a Property. It consists, in the case of an attribute, of the corresponding Classifier, and in the case of an association end, all of the Classifiers at the other ends.

expressions.body:
result = (if association <> null
then association.memberEnd->excluding(self)->collect(type)->asSet()
else 
  if classifier<>null
  then classifier->asSet()
  else Set{} 
  endif
endif)

definitions.name: Property.subsetting_context_conforms
descriptions: Subsetting may only occur when the context of the subsetting property conforms to the context of the subsetted property.

expressions.body:
subsettedProperty->notEmpty() implies
  (subsettingContext()->notEmpty() and subsettingContext()->forAll (sc |
    subsettedProperty->forAll(sp |
      sp.subsettingContext()->exists(c | sc.conformsTo(c)))))

definitions.name: Property.derived_union_is_read_only
descriptions: A derived union is read only.

definitions.name: Property.multiplicity_of_composite
descriptions: A multiplicity on the composing end of a composite aggregation must not have an upper bound greater than 1.

expressions.body: isComposite and association <> null implies opposite.upperBound() <= 1

definitions.name: Property.redefined_property_inherited
descriptions: A redefined Property must be inherited from a more general Classifier.

definitions.name: Property.subsetting_rules
descriptions: A subsetting Property may strengthen the type of the subsetted Property, and its upper bound may be less.

expressions.body:
subsettedProperty->forAll(sp |
  self.type.conformsTo(sp.type) and
    ((self.upperBound()->notEmpty() and sp.upperBound()->notEmpty()) implies
      self.upperBound() <= sp.upperBound() ))

definitions.name: Property.binding_to_attribute
descriptions: A binding of a PropertyTemplateParameter representing an attribute must be to an attribute.
definitions.limitation: The XMI casts ts.formal itself to Property although formal is a TemplateParameter. Python checks formal.parameteredElement against the attribute requirement.

definitions.name: Property.derived_union_is_derived
descriptions: A derived union is derived.

definitions.name: Property.deployment_target
descriptions: A Property can be a DeploymentTarget if it is a kind of Node and functions as a part in the internal structure of an encompassing Node.

expressions.body: deployment->notEmpty() implies owner.oclIsKindOf(Node) and Node.allInstances()->exists(n | n.part->exists(p | p = self))

definitions.name: Property.subsetted_property_names
descriptions: A Property may not subset a Property with the same name.

definitions.name: Property.type_of_opposite_end
descriptions: If a Property is a classifier-owned end of a binary Association, its owner must be the type of the opposite end.

definitions.name: Property.qualified_is_association_end
descriptions: All qualified Properties must be Association ends

definitions.name: Property.aggregation
descriptions: Specifies the kind of aggregation that applies to the Property.

definitions.name: Property.association
descriptions: The Association of which this Property is a member, if any.

definitions.name: Property.associationEnd
descriptions: Designates the optional association end that owns a qualifier attribute.

definitions.name: Property.class
descriptions: The Class that owns this Property, if any.

definitions.name: Property.datatype
descriptions: The DataType that owns this Property, if any.

definitions.name: Property.defaultValue
descriptions: A ValueSpecification that is evaluated to give a default value for the Property when an instance of the owning Classifier is instantiated.

definitions.name: Property.interface
descriptions: The Interface that owns this Property, if any.

definitions.name: Property.isComposite
descriptions: If isComposite is true, the object containing the attribute is a container for the object or value contained in the attribute. This is a derived value, indicating whether the aggregation of the Property is composite or not.

definitions.name: Property.isDerived
descriptions: Specifies whether the Property is derived, i.e., whether its value or values can be computed from other information.

definitions.name: Property.isDerivedUnion
descriptions: Specifies whether the property is derived as the union of all of the Properties that are constrained to subset it.

definitions.name: Property.isID
descriptions: True indicates this property can be used to uniquely identify an instance of the containing Class.

definitions.name: Property.opposite
descriptions: In the case where the Property is one end of a binary association this gives the other end.
definitions.limitation: The property is optional and the query returns null for a non-binary or absent association.

definitions.name: Property.owningAssociation
descriptions: The owning association of this property, if any.

definitions.name: Property.qualifier
descriptions: An optional list of ordered qualifier attributes for the end.

definitions.name: Property.redefinedProperty
descriptions: The properties that are redefined by this property, if any.

definitions.name: Property.subsettedProperty
descriptions: The properties of which this Property is constrained to be a subset, if any.

definitions.name: Property
descriptions: A Property is a StructuralFeature. A Property related by ownedAttribute to a Classifier (other than an association) represents an attribute and might also represent an association end. It relates an instance of the Classifier to a value or set of values of the type of the attribute. A Property related by memberEnd to an Association represents an end of the Association. The type of the Property is the type of the end of the Association. A Property has the capability of being a DeploymentTarget in a Deployment relationship. This enables modeling the deployment to hierarchical nodes that have Properties functioning as internal parts.  Property specializes ParameterableElement to specify that a Property can be exposed as a formal template parameter, and provided as an actual parameter in a binding of a template.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.isConsistentWith
descriptions: The query isConsistentWith() specifies, for any two RedefinableElements in a context in which redefinition is possible, whether redefinition would be logically consistent. By default, this is false; this operation must be overridden for subclasses of RedefinableElement to define the consistency conditions.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.isRedefinitionContextValid
descriptions: The query isRedefinitionContextValid() specifies whether the redefinition contexts of this RedefinableElement are properly related to the redefinition contexts of the specified RedefinableElement to allow this element to redefine the other. By default at least one of the redefinition contexts of this element must be a specialization of at least one of the redefinition contexts of the specified element.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.redefinition_consistent
descriptions: A redefining element must be consistent with each redefined element.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.non_leaf_redefinition
descriptions: A RedefinableElement can only redefine non-leaf RedefinableElements.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.redefinition_context_valid
descriptions: At least one of the redefinition contexts of the redefining element must be a specialization of at least one of the redefinition contexts for each redefined element.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.isLeaf
descriptions: Indicates whether it is possible to further redefine a RedefinableElement. If the value is true, then it is not possible to further redefine the RedefinableElement.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.redefinedElement
descriptions: The RedefinableElement that is being redefined by this element.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement.redefinitionContext
descriptions: The contexts that this element may be redefined from.

definitions.name: RedefinableElement
descriptions: A RedefinableElement is an element that, when defined in the context of a Classifier, can be redefined more specifically or differently in the context of another Classifier that specializes (directly or indirectly) the context Classifier.

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature.inheritedParameter
descriptions: Derivation for RedefinableTemplateSignature::/inheritedParameter

expressions.body: result = (if extendedSignature->isEmpty() then Set{} else extendedSignature.parameter->asSet() endif)

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature.isConsistentWith
descriptions: The query isConsistentWith() specifies, for any two RedefinableTemplateSignatures in a context in which redefinition is possible, whether redefinition would be logically consistent. A redefining template signature is always consistent with a redefined template signature, as redefinition only adds new formal parameters.

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature.redefines_parents
descriptions: If any of the parent Classifiers are a template, then the extendedSignature must include the signature of that Classifier.

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature.classifier
descriptions: The Classifier that owns this RedefinableTemplateSignature.

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature.extendedSignature
descriptions: The signatures extended by this RedefinableTemplateSignature.

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature.inheritedParameter
descriptions: The formal template parameters of the extended signatures.

definitions.name: RedefinableTemplateSignature
descriptions: A RedefinableTemplateSignature supports the addition of formal template parameters in a specialization of a template classifier.

definitions.name: Slot.definingFeature
descriptions: The StructuralFeature that specifies the values that may be held by the Slot.

definitions.name: Slot.owningInstance
descriptions: The InstanceSpecification that owns this Slot.

definitions.name: Slot.value
descriptions: The value or values held by the Slot.

definitions.name: Slot
descriptions: A Slot designates that an entity modeled by an InstanceSpecification has a value or values for a specific StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: StructuralFeature.isReadOnly
descriptions: If isReadOnly is true, the StructuralFeature may not be written to after initialization.

definitions.name: StructuralFeature
descriptions: A StructuralFeature is a typed feature of a Classifier that specifies the structure of instances of the Classifier.

definitions.name: ValueSpecificationAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 1..1

definitions.name: ValueSpecificationAction.compatible_type
descriptions: The type of the value ValueSpecification must conform to the type of the result OutputPin.

definitions.name: ValueSpecificationAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the result value is placed.

definitions.name: ValueSpecificationAction.value
descriptions: The ValueSpecification to be evaluated.

definitions.name: ValueSpecificationAction
descriptions: A ValueSpecificationAction is an Action that evaluates a ValueSpecification and provides a result.

definitions.name: VariableAction.scope_of_variable
descriptions: The VariableAction must be in the scope of the variable.

definitions.name: VariableAction.variable
descriptions: The Variable to be read or written.

definitions.name: VariableAction
descriptions: VariableAction is an abstract class for Actions that operate on a specified Variable.

definitions.name: WriteLinkAction.allow_access
descriptions: The visibility of at least one end must allow access from the context Classifier of the WriteLinkAction.

expressions.body:
endData.end->exists(end |
  end.type=_'context' or
  end.visibility=VisibilityKind::public or 
  end.visibility=VisibilityKind::protected and
  endData.end->exists(other | 
    other<>end and _'context'.conformsTo(other.type.oclAsType(Classifier))))

definitions.name: WriteLinkAction
descriptions: WriteLinkAction is an abstract class for LinkActions that create and destroy links.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction.multiplicity_of_result
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin must be 1..1.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction.type_of_value
descriptions: The type of the value InputPin must conform to the type of the structuralFeature.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction.multiplicity_of_value
descriptions: The multiplicity of the value InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction.type_of_result
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is the same as the type of the inherited object InputPin.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which is put the input object as modified by the WriteStructuralFeatureAction.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction.value
descriptions: The InputPin that provides the value to be added or removed from the StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: WriteStructuralFeatureAction
descriptions: WriteStructuralFeatureAction is an abstract class for StructuralFeatureActions that change StructuralFeature values.

definitions.name: WriteVariableAction.value_type
descriptions: The type of the value InputPin must conform to the type of the variable.

definitions.name: WriteVariableAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the value InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: WriteVariableAction.value
descriptions: The InputPin that gives the value to be added or removed from the Variable.

definitions.name: WriteVariableAction
descriptions: WriteVariableAction is an abstract class for VariableActions that change Variable values.

definitions.name: AcceptCallAction.result_pins
descriptions: The number of result OutputPins must be the same as the number of input (in and inout) ownedParameters of the Operation specified by the trigger Event. The type, ordering and multiplicity of each result OutputPin must be consistent with the corresponding input Parameter.

expressions.body:
let parameter: OrderedSet(Parameter) = trigger.event->asSequence()->first().oclAsType(CallEvent).operation.inputParameters() in
result->size() = parameter->size() and
Sequence{1..result->size()}->forAll(i | 
	parameter->at(i).type.conformsTo(result->at(i).type) and 
	parameter->at(i).isOrdered = result->at(i).isOrdered and
	parameter->at(i).compatibleWith(result->at(i)))

definitions.name: AcceptCallAction.trigger_call_event
descriptions: The action must have exactly one trigger, which must be for a CallEvent.

definitions.name: AcceptCallAction.unmarshall
descriptions: isUnmrashall must be true for an AcceptCallAction.

definitions.name: AcceptCallAction.returnInformation
descriptions: An OutputPin where a value is placed containing sufficient information to perform a subsequent ReplyAction and return control to the caller. The contents of this value are opaque. It can be passed and copied but it cannot be manipulated by the model.

definitions.name: AcceptCallAction
descriptions: An AcceptCallAction is an AcceptEventAction that handles the receipt of a synchronous call request. In addition to the values from the Operation input parameters, the Action produces an output that is needed later to supply the information to the ReplyAction necessary to return control to the caller. An AcceptCallAction is for synchronous calls. If it is used to handle an asynchronous call, execution of the subsequent ReplyAction will complete immediately with no effect.

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.one_output_pin
descriptions: If isUnmarshall=false and any of the triggers are for SignalEvents or TimeEvents, there must be exactly one result OutputPin with multiplicity 1..1.

expressions.body:
not isUnmarshall and trigger->exists(event.oclIsKindOf(SignalEvent) or event.oclIsKindOf(TimeEvent)) implies 
	output->size() = 1 and output->first().is(1,1)

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.no_input_pins
descriptions: AcceptEventActions may have no input pins.

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.no_output_pins
descriptions: There are no OutputPins if the trigger events are only ChangeEvents and/or CallEvents when this action is an instance of AcceptEventAction and not an instance of a descendant of AcceptEventAction (such as AcceptCallAction).

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.unmarshall_signal_events
descriptions: If isUnmarshall is true (and this is not an AcceptCallAction), there must be exactly one trigger, which is for a SignalEvent. The number of result output pins must be the same as the number of attributes of the signal. The type and ordering of each result output pin must be the same as the corresponding attribute of the signal. The multiplicity of each result output pin must be compatible with the multiplicity of the corresponding attribute.

expressions.body:
isUnmarshall and self.oclIsTypeOf(AcceptEventAction) implies
	trigger->size()=1 and
	trigger->asSequence()->first().event.oclIsKindOf(SignalEvent) and
	let attribute: OrderedSet(Property) = trigger->asSequence()->first().event.oclAsType(SignalEvent).signal.allAttributes() in
	attribute->size()>0 and result->size() = attribute->size() and
	Sequence{1..result->size()}->forAll(i | 
		result->at(i).type = attribute->at(i).type and 
		result->at(i).isOrdered = attribute->at(i).isOrdered and
		result->at(i).includesMultiplicity(attribute->at(i)))

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.conforming_type
descriptions: If isUnmarshall=false and all the triggers are for SignalEvents, then the type of the single result OutputPin must either be null or all the signals must conform to it.

expressions.body:
not isUnmarshall implies 
	result->isEmpty() or
	let type: Type = result->first().type in type=null or 
		(trigger->forAll(event.oclIsKindOf(SignalEvent)) and 
		 trigger.event.oclAsType(SignalEvent).signal->forAll(s | s.conformsTo(type)))

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.isUnmarshall
descriptions: Indicates whether there is a single OutputPin for a SignalEvent occurrence, or multiple OutputPins for attribute values of the instance of the Signal associated with a SignalEvent occurrence.

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.result
descriptions: OutputPins holding the values received from an Event occurrence.

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction.trigger
descriptions: The Triggers specifying the Events of which the AcceptEventAction waits for occurrences.

definitions.name: AcceptEventAction
descriptions: An AcceptEventAction is an Action that waits for the occurrence of one or more specific Events.

definitions.name: Action.context
descriptions: The derivation for the context property.

expressions.body:
result = (let behavior: Behavior = self.containingBehavior() in
if behavior=null then null
else if behavior._'context' = null then behavior
else behavior._'context'
endif
endif)

definitions.name: Action.allActions
descriptions: Return this Action and all Actions contained directly or indirectly in it. By default only the Action itself is returned, but the operation is overridden for StructuredActivityNodes.

definitions.name: Action.allOwnedNodes
descriptions: Returns all the ActivityNodes directly or indirectly owned by this Action. This includes at least all the Pins of the Action.

expressions.body:
result = (if inStructuredNode<>null then inStructuredNode.containingBehavior() 
else if activity<>null then activity
else interaction 
endif
endif
)

definitions.name: Action.context
descriptions: The context Classifier of the Behavior that contains this Action, or the Behavior itself if it has no context.

definitions.name: Action.input
descriptions: The ordered set of InputPins representing the inputs to the Action.

definitions.name: Action.isLocallyReentrant
descriptions: If true, the Action can begin a new, concurrent execution, even if there is already another execution of the Action ongoing. If false, the Action cannot begin a new execution until any previous execution has completed.

definitions.name: Action.localPostcondition
