descriptions: A Constraint that must be satisfied when execution of the Action is completed.

definitions.name: Action.localPrecondition
descriptions: A Constraint that must be satisfied when execution of the Action is started.

definitions.name: Action.output
descriptions: The ordered set of OutputPins representing outputs from the Action.

definitions.name: Action
descriptions: An Action is the fundamental unit of executable functionality. The execution of an Action represents some transformation or processing in the modeled system. Actions provide the ExecutableNodes within Activities and may also be used within Interactions.

definitions.name: ActionInputPin.input_pin
descriptions: The fromAction of an ActionInputPin must only have ActionInputPins as InputPins.

definitions.name: ActionInputPin.one_output_pin
descriptions: The fromAction of an ActionInputPin must have exactly one OutputPin.

definitions.name: ActionInputPin.no_control_or_object_flow
descriptions: The fromAction of an ActionInputPin cannot have ActivityEdges coming into or out of it or its Pins.
definitions.limitation: The source unions fromAction.incoming with the receiving pin outgoing. Python checks fromAction.outgoing as the producer-isolation prose requires.

definitions.name: ActionInputPin.fromAction
descriptions: The Action used to provide the values of the ActionInputPin.

definitions.name: ActionInputPin
descriptions: An ActionInputPin is a kind of InputPin that executes an Action to determine the values to input to another Action.

definitions.name: AddStructuralFeatureValueAction.required_value
descriptions: A value InputPin is required.

definitions.name: AddStructuralFeatureValueAction.insertAt_pin
descriptions: AddStructuralFeatureActions adding a value to ordered StructuralFeatures must have a single InputPin for the insertion point with type UnlimitedNatural and multiplicity of 1..1 if isReplaceAll=false, and must have no Input Pin for the insertion point when the StructuralFeature is unordered.

expressions.body:
if not structuralFeature.isOrdered then insertAt = null
else 
  not isReplaceAll implies
  	insertAt<>null and 
  	insertAt->forAll(type=UnlimitedNatural and is(1,1.oclAsType(UnlimitedNatural)))
endif

definitions.name: AddStructuralFeatureValueAction.insertAt
descriptions: The InputPin that gives the position at which to insert the value in an ordered StructuralFeature. The type of the insertAt InputPin is UnlimitedNatural, but the value cannot be zero. It is omitted for unordered StructuralFeatures.

definitions.name: AddStructuralFeatureValueAction.isReplaceAll
descriptions: Specifies whether existing values of the StructuralFeature should be removed before adding the new value.

definitions.name: AddStructuralFeatureValueAction
descriptions: An AddStructuralFeatureValueAction is a WriteStructuralFeatureAction for adding values to a StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: AddVariableValueAction.required_value
descriptions: A value InputPin is required.

definitions.name: AddVariableValueAction.insertAt_pin
descriptions: AddVariableValueActions for ordered Variables must have a single InputPin for the insertion point with type UnlimtedNatural and multiplicity of 1..1 if isReplaceAll=false, otherwise the Action has no InputPin for the insertion point.

expressions.body:
if not variable.isOrdered then insertAt = null
else 
  not isReplaceAll implies
  	insertAt<>null and 
  	insertAt->forAll(type=UnlimitedNatural and is(1,1.oclAsType(UnlimitedNatural)))
endif

definitions.name: AddVariableValueAction.insertAt
descriptions: The InputPin that gives the position at which to insert a new value or move an existing value in ordered Variables. The type of the insertAt InputPin is UnlimitedNatural, but the value cannot be zero. It is omitted for unordered Variables.

definitions.name: AddVariableValueAction.isReplaceAll
descriptions: Specifies whether existing values of the Variable should be removed before adding the new value.

definitions.name: AddVariableValueAction
descriptions: An AddVariableValueAction is a WriteVariableAction for adding values to a Variable.

definitions.name: BroadcastSignalAction.number_of_arguments
descriptions: The number of argument InputPins must be the same as the number of attributes in the signal.

definitions.name: BroadcastSignalAction.type_ordering_multiplicity
descriptions: The type, ordering, and multiplicity of an argument InputPin must be the same as the corresponding attribute of the signal.

expressions.body:
let attribute: OrderedSet(Property) = signal.allAttributes() in
Sequence{1..argument->size()}->forAll(i | 
	argument->at(i).type.conformsTo(attribute->at(i).type) and 
	argument->at(i).isOrdered = attribute->at(i).isOrdered and
	argument->at(i).compatibleWith(attribute->at(i)))

definitions.name: BroadcastSignalAction.no_onport
descriptions: A BroadcaseSignalAction may not specify onPort.

definitions.name: BroadcastSignalAction.signal
descriptions: The Signal whose instances are to be sent.

definitions.name: BroadcastSignalAction
descriptions: A BroadcastSignalAction is an InvocationAction that transmits a Signal instance to all the potential target objects in the system. Values from the argument InputPins are used to provide values for the attributes of the Signal. The requestor continues execution immediately after the Signal instances are sent out and cannot receive reply values.

definitions.name: CallAction.inputParameters
descriptions: Return the in and inout ownedParameters of the Behavior or Operation being called. (This operation is abstract and should be overridden by subclasses of CallAction.)

definitions.name: CallAction.outputParameters
descriptions: Return the inout, out and return ownedParameters of the Behavior or Operation being called. (This operation is abstract and should be overridden by subclasses of CallAction.)

definitions.name: CallAction.argument_pins
descriptions: The number of argument InputPins must be the same as the number of input (in and inout) ownedParameters of the called Behavior or Operation. The type, ordering and multiplicity of each argument InputPin must be consistent with the corresponding input Parameter.

expressions.body:
let parameter: OrderedSet(Parameter) = self.inputParameters() in
argument->size() = parameter->size() and
Sequence{1..argument->size()}->forAll(i | 
	argument->at(i).type.conformsTo(parameter->at(i).type) and 
	argument->at(i).isOrdered = parameter->at(i).isOrdered and
	argument->at(i).compatibleWith(parameter->at(i)))

definitions.name: CallAction.result_pins
descriptions: The number of result OutputPins must be the same as the number of output (inout, out and return) ownedParameters of the called Behavior or Operation. The type, ordering and multiplicity of each result OutputPin must be consistent with the corresponding input Parameter.

expressions.body:
let parameter: OrderedSet(Parameter) = self.outputParameters() in
result->size() = parameter->size() and
Sequence{1..result->size()}->forAll(i | 
	parameter->at(i).type.conformsTo(result->at(i).type) and 
	parameter->at(i).isOrdered = result->at(i).isOrdered and
	parameter->at(i).compatibleWith(result->at(i)))

definitions.name: CallAction.synchronous_call
descriptions: Only synchronous CallActions can have result OutputPins.

definitions.name: CallAction.isSynchronous
descriptions: If true, the call is synchronous and the caller waits for completion of the invoked Behavior. If false, the call is asynchronous and the caller proceeds immediately and cannot receive return values.

definitions.name: CallAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPins on which the reply values from the invocation are placed (if the call is synchronous).

definitions.name: CallAction
descriptions: CallAction is an abstract class for Actions that invoke a Behavior with given argument values and (if the invocation is synchronous) receive reply values.

definitions.name: CallBehaviorAction.outputParameters
descriptions: Return the inout, out and return ownedParameters of the Behavior being called.

definitions.name: CallBehaviorAction.inputParameters
descriptions: Return the in and inout ownedParameters of the Behavior being called.

definitions.name: CallBehaviorAction.no_onport
descriptions: A CallBehaviorAction may not specify onPort.

definitions.name: CallBehaviorAction.behavior
descriptions: The Behavior being invoked.

definitions.name: CallBehaviorAction
descriptions: A CallBehaviorAction is a CallAction that invokes a Behavior directly. The argument values of the CallBehaviorAction are passed on the input Parameters of the invoked Behavior. If the call is synchronous, the execution of the CallBehaviorAction waits until the execution of the invoked Behavior completes and the values of output Parameters of the Behavior are placed on the result OutputPins. If the call is asynchronous, the CallBehaviorAction completes immediately and no results values can be provided.

definitions.name: CallOperationAction.outputParameters
descriptions: Return the inout, out and return ownedParameters of the Operation being called.

definitions.name: CallOperationAction.inputParameters
descriptions: Return the in and inout ownedParameters of the Operation being called.

definitions.name: CallOperationAction.type_target_pin
descriptions: If onPort has no value, the operation must be an owned or inherited feature of the type of the target InputPin, otherwise the Port given by onPort must be an owned or inherited feature of the type of the target InputPin, and the Port must have a required or provided Interface with the operation as an owned or inherited feature.

definitions.name: CallOperationAction.operation
descriptions: The Operation being invoked.

definitions.name: CallOperationAction.target
descriptions: The InputPin that provides the target object to which the Operation call request is sent.

definitions.name: CallOperationAction
descriptions: A CallOperationAction is a CallAction that transmits an Operation call request to the target object, where it may cause the invocation of associated Behavior. The argument values of the CallOperationAction are passed on the input Parameters of the Operation. If call is synchronous, the execution of the CallOperationAction waits until the execution of the invoked Operation completes and the values of output Parameters of the Operation are placed on the result OutputPins. If the call is asynchronous, the CallOperationAction completes immediately and no results values can be provided.

definitions.name: Clause.body_output_pins
descriptions: The bodyOutput Pins are OutputPins on Actions in the body of the Clause.

definitions.name: Clause.decider_output
descriptions: The decider Pin must be on an Action in the test section of the Clause and must be of type Boolean with multiplicity 1..1.

definitions.name: Clause.test_and_body
descriptions: The test and body parts of a ConditionalNode must be disjoint with each other.

definitions.name: Clause.body
descriptions: The set of ExecutableNodes that are executed if the test evaluates to true and the Clause is chosen over other Clauses within the ConditionalNode that also have tests that evaluate to true.

definitions.name: Clause.bodyOutput
descriptions: The OutputPins on Actions within the body section whose values are moved to the result OutputPins of the containing ConditionalNode after execution of the body.

definitions.name: Clause.decider
descriptions: An OutputPin on an Action in the test section whose Boolean value determines the result of the test.

definitions.name: Clause.predecessorClause
descriptions: A set of Clauses whose tests must all evaluate to false before this Clause can evaluate its test.

definitions.name: Clause.successorClause
descriptions: A set of Clauses that may not evaluate their tests unless the test for this Clause evaluates to false.

definitions.name: Clause.test
descriptions: The set of ExecutableNodes that are executed in order to provide a test result for the Clause.

definitions.name: Clause
descriptions: A Clause is an Element that represents a single branch of a ConditionalNode, including a test and a body section. The body section is executed only if (but not necessarily if) the test section evaluates to true.

definitions.name: ClearAssociationAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ClearAssociationAction.same_type
descriptions: The type of the InputPin must conform to the type of at least one of the memberEnds of the association.

definitions.name: ClearAssociationAction.association
descriptions: The Association to be cleared.

definitions.name: ClearAssociationAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin that gives the object whose participation in the Association is to be cleared.

definitions.name: ClearAssociationAction
descriptions: A ClearAssociationAction is an Action that destroys all links of an Association in which a particular object participates.

definitions.name: ClearStructuralFeatureAction.type_of_result
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is the same as the type of the inherited object InputPin.

definitions.name: ClearStructuralFeatureAction.multiplicity_of_result
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin must be 1..1.

definitions.name: ClearStructuralFeatureAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which is put the input object as modified by the ClearStructuralFeatureAction.

definitions.name: ClearStructuralFeatureAction
descriptions: A ClearStructuralFeatureAction is a StructuralFeatureAction that removes all values of a StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: ClearVariableAction
descriptions: A ClearVariableAction is a VariableAction that removes all values of a Variable.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.allActions
descriptions: Return only this ConditionalNode. This prevents Actions within the ConditionalNode from having their OutputPins used as bodyOutputs or decider Pins in containing LoopNodes or ConditionalNodes.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.result_no_incoming
descriptions: The result OutputPins have no incoming edges.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.no_input_pins
descriptions: A ConditionalNode has no InputPins.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.one_clause_with_executable_node
descriptions: No ExecutableNode in the ConditionNode may appear in the test or body part of more than one clause of a ConditionalNode.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.matching_output_pins
descriptions: Each clause of a ConditionalNode must have the same number of bodyOutput pins as the ConditionalNode has result OutputPins, and each clause bodyOutput Pin must be compatible with the corresponding result OutputPin (by positional order) in type, multiplicity, ordering, and uniqueness.

expressions.body:
clause->forAll(
	bodyOutput->size()=self.result->size() and
	Sequence{1..self.result->size()}->forAll(i |
		bodyOutput->at(i).type.conformsTo(result->at(i).type) and
		bodyOutput->at(i).isOrdered = result->at(i).isOrdered and
		bodyOutput->at(i).isUnique = result->at(i).isUnique and
		bodyOutput->at(i).compatibleWith(result->at(i))))

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.executable_nodes
descriptions: The union of the ExecutableNodes in the test and body parts of all clauses must be the same as the subset of nodes contained in the ConditionalNode (considered as a StructuredActivityNode) that are ExecutableNodes.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.clause_no_predecessor
descriptions: No two clauses within a ConditionalNode may be predecessorClauses of each other, either directly or indirectly.
definitions.limitation: The source closure rejects ordinary acyclic predecessors within the same node. Python rejects predecessor cycles, preserving the project interpretation used for clause sequencing.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.clause
descriptions: The set of Clauses composing the ConditionalNode.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.isAssured
descriptions: If true, the modeler asserts that the test for at least one Clause of the ConditionalNode will succeed.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.isDeterminate
descriptions: If true, the modeler asserts that the test for at most one Clause of the ConditionalNode will succeed.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode.result
descriptions: The OutputPins that onto which are moved values from the bodyOutputs of the Clause selected for execution.

definitions.name: ConditionalNode
descriptions: A ConditionalNode is a StructuredActivityNode that chooses one among some number of alternative collections of ExecutableNodes to execute.

definitions.name: CreateLinkAction.association_not_abstract
descriptions: The Association cannot be an abstract Classifier.

definitions.name: CreateLinkAction.endData
descriptions: The LinkEndData that specifies the values to be placed on the Association ends for the new link.

definitions.name: CreateLinkAction
descriptions: A CreateLinkAction is a WriteLinkAction for creating links.

definitions.name: CreateLinkObjectAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the OutputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: CreateLinkObjectAction.type_of_result
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin must be the same as the Association of the CreateLinkObjectAction.

definitions.name: CreateLinkObjectAction.association_class
descriptions: The Association must be an AssociationClass.

definitions.name: CreateLinkObjectAction.result
descriptions: The output pin on which the newly created link object is placed.

definitions.name: CreateLinkObjectAction
descriptions: A CreateLinkObjectAction is a CreateLinkAction for creating link objects (AssociationClasse instances).

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction.classifier_not_abstract
descriptions: The classifier cannot be abstract.

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction.classifier_not_association_class
descriptions: The classifier cannot be an AssociationClass.

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction.same_type
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin must be the same as the classifier of the CreateObjectAction.

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction.classifier
descriptions: The Classifier to be instantiated.

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the newly created object is placed.

definitions.name: CreateObjectAction
descriptions: A CreateObjectAction is an Action that creates an instance of the specified Classifier.

definitions.name: DestroyLinkAction.endData
descriptions: The LinkEndData that the values of the Association ends for the links to be destroyed.

definitions.name: DestroyLinkAction
descriptions: A DestroyLinkAction is a WriteLinkAction that destroys links (including link objects).

definitions.name: DestroyObjectAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the targe IinputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: DestroyObjectAction.no_type
descriptions: The target InputPin has no type.

definitions.name: DestroyObjectAction.isDestroyLinks
descriptions: Specifies whether links in which the object participates are destroyed along with the object.

definitions.name: DestroyObjectAction.isDestroyOwnedObjects
descriptions: Specifies whether objects owned by the object (via composition) are destroyed along with the object.

definitions.name: DestroyObjectAction.target
descriptions: The InputPin providing the object to be destroyed.

definitions.name: DestroyObjectAction
descriptions: A DestroyObjectAction is an Action that destroys objects.

definitions.name: ExpansionNode.region_as_input_or_output
descriptions: One of regionAsInput or regionAsOutput must be non-empty, but not both.

definitions.name: ExpansionNode.regionAsInput
descriptions: The ExpansionRegion for which the ExpansionNode is an input.

definitions.name: ExpansionNode.regionAsOutput
descriptions: The ExpansionRegion for which the ExpansionNode is an output.

definitions.name: ExpansionNode
descriptions: An ExpansionNode is an ObjectNode used to indicate a collection input or output for an ExpansionRegion. A collection input of an ExpansionRegion contains a collection that is broken into its individual elements inside the region, whose content is executed once per element. A collection output of an ExpansionRegion combines individual elements produced by the execution of the region into a collection for use outside the region.

definitions.name: ExpansionRegion.inputElement
descriptions: The ExpansionNodes that hold the input collections for the ExpansionRegion.

definitions.name: ExpansionRegion.mode
descriptions: The mode in which the ExpansionRegion executes its contents. If parallel, executions are concurrent. If iterative, executions are sequential. If stream, a stream of values flows into a single execution.

definitions.name: ExpansionRegion.outputElement
descriptions: The ExpansionNodes that form the output collections of the ExpansionRegion.

definitions.name: ExpansionRegion
descriptions: An ExpansionRegion is a StructuredActivityNode that executes its content multiple times corresponding to elements of input collection(s).

definitions.name: InputPin.outgoing_edges_structured_only
descriptions: An InputPin may have outgoing ActivityEdges only when it is owned by a StructuredActivityNode, and these edges must target a node contained (directly or indirectly) in the owning StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: InputPin
descriptions: An InputPin is a Pin that holds input values to be consumed by an Action.

definitions.name: InvocationAction.argument
descriptions: The InputPins that provide the argument values passed in the invocation request.

definitions.name: InvocationAction.onPort
descriptions: For CallOperationActions, SendSignalActions, and SendObjectActions, an optional Port of the target object through which the invocation request is sent.

definitions.name: InvocationAction
descriptions: InvocationAction is an abstract class for the various actions that request Behavior invocation.

definitions.name: LinkAction.association
descriptions: Returns the Association acted on by this LinkAction.

definitions.name: LinkAction.same_pins
descriptions: The inputValue InputPins is the same as the union of all the InputPins referenced by the endData.

definitions.name: LinkAction.same_association
descriptions: The ends of the endData must all be from the same Association and include all and only the memberEnds of that association.

definitions.name: LinkAction.not_static
descriptions: The ends of the endData must not be static.

definitions.name: LinkAction.endData
descriptions: The LinkEndData identifying the values on the ends of the links acting on by this LinkAction.

definitions.name: LinkAction.inputValue
descriptions: InputPins used by the LinkEndData of the LinkAction.

definitions.name: LinkAction
descriptions: LinkAction is an abstract class for all Actions that identify the links to be acted on using LinkEndData.

definitions.name: LinkEndCreationData.allPins
descriptions: Adds the insertAt InputPin (if any) to the set of all Pins.
definitions.limitation: The source including(insertAt) includes null when the optional insertion pin is absent. Python omits absent pins, matching the description and non-null result element contract.

definitions.name: LinkEndCreationData.insertAt_pin
descriptions: LinkEndCreationData for ordered Association ends must have a single insertAt InputPin for the insertion point with type UnlimitedNatural and multiplicity of 1..1, if isReplaceAll=false, and must have no InputPin for the insertion point when the association ends are unordered.

expressions.body:
if  not end.isOrdered
then insertAt = null
else
	not isReplaceAll=false implies
	insertAt <> null and insertAt->forAll(type=UnlimitedNatural and is(1,1))
endif

definitions.limitation: The source not isReplaceAll=false reverses the guard. Python requires an insertion pin when an ordered end is not replacing all values, according to the prose.

definitions.name: LinkEndCreationData.insertAt
descriptions: For ordered Association ends, the InputPin that provides the position where the new link should be inserted or where an existing link should be moved to. The type of the insertAt InputPin is UnlimitedNatural, but the input cannot be zero. It is omitted for Association ends that are not ordered.

definitions.name: LinkEndCreationData.isReplaceAll
descriptions: Specifies whether the existing links emanating from the object on this end should be destroyed before creating a new link.

definitions.name: LinkEndCreationData
descriptions: LinkEndCreationData is LinkEndData used to provide values for one end of a link to be created by a CreateLinkAction.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.allPins
descriptions: Returns all the InputPins referenced by this LinkEndData. By default this includes the value and qualifier InputPins, but subclasses may override the operation to add other InputPins.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.same_type
descriptions: The type of the value InputPin conforms to the type of the Association end.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the value InputPin must be 1..1.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.end_object_input_pin
descriptions: The value InputPin is not also the qualifier value InputPin.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.property_is_association_end
descriptions: The Property must be an Association memberEnd.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.qualifiers
descriptions: The qualifiers must be qualifiers of the Association end.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.end
descriptions: The Association end for which this LinkEndData specifies values.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.qualifier
descriptions: A set of QualifierValues used to provide values for the qualifiers of the end.

definitions.name: LinkEndData.value
descriptions: The InputPin that provides the specified value for the given end. This InputPin is omitted if the LinkEndData specifies the "open" end for a ReadLinkAction.

definitions.name: LinkEndData
descriptions: LinkEndData is an Element that identifies on end of a link to be read or written by a LinkAction. As a link (that is not a link object) cannot be passed as a runtime value to or from an Action, it is instead identified by its end objects and qualifier values, if any. A LinkEndData instance provides these values for a single Association end.

definitions.name: LinkEndDestructionData.allPins
descriptions: Adds the destroyAt InputPin (if any) to the set of all Pins.
definitions.limitation: The source including(destroyAt) includes null when the optional destruction pin is absent. Python omits absent pins, matching the description and non-null result element contract.

definitions.name: LinkEndDestructionData.destroyAt_pin
descriptions: LinkEndDestructionData for ordered, nonunique Association ends must have a single destroyAt InputPin if isDestroyDuplicates is false, which must be of type UnlimitedNatural and have a multiplicity of 1..1. Otherwise, the action has no destroyAt input pin.

expressions.body:
if  not end.isOrdered or end.isUnique or isDestroyDuplicates
then destroyAt = null
else
	destroyAt <> null and 
	destroyAt->forAll(type=UnlimitedNatural and is(1,1))
endif

definitions.name: LinkEndDestructionData.destroyAt
descriptions: The InputPin that provides the position of an existing link to be destroyed in an ordered, nonunique Association end. The type of the destroyAt InputPin is UnlimitedNatural, but the value cannot be zero or unlimited.

definitions.name: LinkEndDestructionData.isDestroyDuplicates
descriptions: Specifies whether to destroy duplicates of the value in nonunique Association ends.

definitions.name: LinkEndDestructionData
descriptions: LinkEndDestructionData is LinkEndData used to provide values for one end of a link to be destroyed by a DestroyLinkAction.

definitions.name: LoopNode.allActions
descriptions: Return only this LoopNode. This prevents Actions within the LoopNode from having their OutputPins used as bodyOutputs or decider Pins in containing LoopNodes or ConditionalNodes.

definitions.name: LoopNode.sourceNodes
descriptions: Return the loopVariable OutputPins in addition to other source nodes for the LoopNode as a StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: LoopNode.result_no_incoming
descriptions: The result OutputPins have no incoming edges.

definitions.name: LoopNode.input_edges
descriptions: The loopVariableInputs must not have outgoing edges.

definitions.name: LoopNode.executable_nodes
descriptions: The union of the ExecutableNodes in the setupPart, test and bodyPart of a LoopNode must be the same as the subset of nodes contained in the LoopNode (considered as a StructuredActivityNode) that are ExecutableNodes.

definitions.name: LoopNode.body_output_pins
descriptions: The bodyOutput pins are OutputPins on Actions in the body of the LoopNode.

definitions.name: LoopNode.setup_test_and_body
descriptions: The test and body parts of a ConditionalNode must be disjoint with each other.

definitions.name: LoopNode.matching_output_pins
descriptions: A LoopNode must have the same number of bodyOutput Pins as loopVariables, and each bodyOutput Pin must be compatible with the corresponding loopVariable (by positional order) in type, multiplicity, ordering and uniqueness.

expressions.body:
bodyOutput->size()=loopVariable->size() and
Sequence{1..loopVariable->size()}->forAll(i |
	bodyOutput->at(i).type.conformsTo(loopVariable->at(i).type) and
	bodyOutput->at(i).isOrdered = loopVariable->at(i).isOrdered and
	bodyOutput->at(i).isUnique = loopVariable->at(i).isUnique and
	loopVariable->at(i).includesMultiplicity(bodyOutput->at(i)))

definitions.name: LoopNode.matching_loop_variables
descriptions: A LoopNode must have the same number of loopVariableInputs and loopVariables, and they must match in type, uniqueness and multiplicity.

definitions.name: LoopNode.matching_result_pins
descriptions: A LoopNode must have the same number of result OutputPins and loopVariables, and they must match in type, uniqueness and multiplicity.

expressions.body:
result->size()=loopVariable->size() and
result.type=loopVariable.type and
result.isUnique=loopVariable.isUnique and
result.lower=loopVariable.lower and
result.upper=loopVariable.upper

definitions.name: LoopNode.loop_variable_outgoing
descriptions: All ActivityEdges outgoing from loopVariable OutputPins must have targets within the LoopNode.

definitions.name: LoopNode.bodyOutput
descriptions: The OutputPins on Actions within the bodyPart, the values of which are moved to the loopVariable OutputPins after the completion of each execution of the bodyPart, before the next iteration of the loop begins or before the loop exits.

definitions.name: LoopNode.bodyPart
descriptions: The set of ExecutableNodes that perform the repetitive computations of the loop. The bodyPart is executed as long as the test section produces a true value.

definitions.name: LoopNode.decider
descriptions: An OutputPin on an Action in the test section whose Boolean value determines whether to continue executing the loop bodyPart.

definitions.name: LoopNode.isTestedFirst
descriptions: If true, the test is performed before the first execution of the bodyPart. If false, the bodyPart is executed once before the test is performed.

definitions.name: LoopNode.loopVariable
descriptions: A list of OutputPins that hold the values of the loop variables during an execution of the loop. When the test fails, the values are moved to the result OutputPins of the loop.

definitions.name: LoopNode.loopVariableInput
descriptions: A list of InputPins whose values are moved into the loopVariable Pins before the first iteration of the loop.

definitions.name: LoopNode.result
descriptions: A list of OutputPins that receive the loopVariable values after the last iteration of the loop and constitute the output of the LoopNode.

definitions.name: LoopNode.setupPart
descriptions: The set of ExecutableNodes executed before the first iteration of the loop, in order to initialize values or perform other setup computations.

definitions.name: LoopNode.test
descriptions: The set of ExecutableNodes executed in order to provide the test result for the loop.

definitions.name: LoopNode
descriptions: A LoopNode is a StructuredActivityNode that represents an iterative loop with setup, test, and body sections.

definitions.name: OpaqueAction.language_body_size
descriptions: If the language attribute is not empty, then the size of the body and language lists must be the same.

definitions.name: OpaqueAction.body
descriptions: Provides a textual specification of the functionality of the Action, in one or more languages other than UML.

definitions.name: OpaqueAction.inputValue
descriptions: The InputPins providing inputs to the OpaqueAction.

definitions.name: OpaqueAction.language
descriptions: If provided, a specification of the language used for each of the body Strings.

definitions.name: OpaqueAction.outputValue
descriptions: The OutputPins on which the OpaqueAction provides outputs.

definitions.name: OpaqueAction
descriptions: An OpaqueAction is an Action whose functionality is not specified within UML.

definitions.name: OutputPin.incoming_edges_structured_only
descriptions: An OutputPin may have incoming ActivityEdges only when it is owned by a StructuredActivityNode, and these edges must have sources contained (directly or indirectly) in the owning StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: OutputPin
descriptions: An OutputPin is a Pin that holds output values produced by an Action.

definitions.name: Pin.control_pins
descriptions: A control Pin has a control type.

definitions.name: Pin.not_unique
descriptions: Pin multiplicity is not unique.

definitions.name: Pin.isControl
descriptions: Indicates whether the Pin provides data to the Action or just controls how the Action executes.

definitions.name: Pin
descriptions: A Pin is an ObjectNode and MultiplicityElement that provides input values to an Action or accepts output values from an Action.

definitions.name: QualifierValue.multiplicity_of_qualifier
descriptions: The multiplicity of the value InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: QualifierValue.type_of_qualifier
descriptions: The type of the value InputPin conforms to the type of the qualifier Property.

definitions.name: QualifierValue.qualifier_attribute
descriptions: The qualifier must be a qualifier of the Association end of the linkEndData that owns this QualifierValue.

definitions.name: QualifierValue.qualifier
descriptions: The qualifier Property for which the value is to be specified.

definitions.name: QualifierValue.value
descriptions: The InputPin from which the specified value for the qualifier is taken.

definitions.name: QualifierValue
descriptions: A QualifierValue is an Element that is used as part of LinkEndData to provide the value for a single qualifier of the end given by the LinkEndData.

definitions.name: RaiseExceptionAction.exception
descriptions: An InputPin whose value becomes the exception object.

definitions.name: RaiseExceptionAction
descriptions: A RaiseExceptionAction is an Action that causes an exception to occur. The input value becomes the exception object.

definitions.name: ReadExtentAction.type_is_classifier
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is the classifier.

definitions.name: ReadExtentAction.multiplicity_of_result
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 0..*.

definitions.name: ReadExtentAction.classifier
descriptions: The Classifier whose instances are to be retrieved.

definitions.name: ReadExtentAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the Classifier instances are placed.

definitions.name: ReadExtentAction
descriptions: A ReadExtentAction is an Action that retrieves the current instances of a Classifier.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.no_type
descriptions: The object InputPin has no type.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.multiplicity_of_output
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.boolean_result
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is Boolean.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.multiplicity_of_input
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.classifier
descriptions: The Classifier against which the classification of the input object is tested.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.isDirect
descriptions: Indicates whether the input object must be directly classified by the given Classifier or whether it may also be an instance of a specialization of the given Classifier.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin that holds the object whose classification is to be tested.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin that holds the Boolean result of the test.

definitions.name: ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction
descriptions: A ReadIsClassifiedObjectAction is an Action that determines whether an object is classified by a given Classifier.

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.openEnd
descriptions: Returns the ends corresponding to endData with no value InputPin. (A well-formed ReadLinkAction is constrained to have only one of these.)

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.type_and_ordering
descriptions: The type and ordering of the result OutputPin are same as the type and ordering of the open Association end.

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.compatible_multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the open Association end must be compatible with the multiplicity of the result OutputPin.

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.visibility
descriptions: Visibility of the open end must allow access from the object performing the action.

expressions.body:
let openEnd : Property = self.openEnd()->first() in
  openEnd.visibility = VisibilityKind::public or 
  endData->exists(oed | 
    oed.end<>openEnd and 
    (_'context' = oed.end.type or 
      (openEnd.visibility = VisibilityKind::protected and 
        _'context'.conformsTo(oed.end.type.oclAsType(Classifier)))))

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.one_open_end
descriptions: Exactly one linkEndData specification (corresponding to the "open" end) must not have an value InputPin.

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.navigable_open_end
descriptions: The open end must be navigable.

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the objects retrieved from the "open" end of those links whose values on other ends are given by the endData.

definitions.name: ReadLinkAction
descriptions: A ReadLinkAction is a LinkAction that navigates across an Association to retrieve the objects on one end.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.property
descriptions: The end Property must be an Association memberEnd.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.multiplicity_of_object
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.ends_of_association
descriptions: The ends of the association must not be static.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.type_of_result
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is the same as the type of the end Property.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.multiplicity_of_result
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.type_of_object
descriptions: The type of the object InputPin is the AssociationClass that owns the end Property.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.association_of_association
descriptions: The association of the end must be an AssociationClass.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.end
descriptions: The Association end to be read.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.object
descriptions: The input pin from which the link object is obtained.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin where the result value is placed.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndAction
descriptions: A ReadLinkObjectEndAction is an Action that retrieves an end object from a link object.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.multiplicity_of_object
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.type_of_object
descriptions: The type of the object InputPin is the AssociationClass that owns the Association end that has the given qualifier Property.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.multiplicity_of_qualifier
descriptions: The multiplicity of the qualifier Property is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.ends_of_association
descriptions: The ends of the Association must not be static.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.multiplicity_of_result
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.same_type
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is the same as the type of the qualifier Property.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.association_of_association
descriptions: The association of the Association end of the qualifier Property must be an AssociationClass.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.qualifier_attribute
descriptions: The qualifier Property must be a qualifier of an Association end.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin from which the link object is obtained.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.qualifier
descriptions: The qualifier Property to be read.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin where the result value is placed.

definitions.name: ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction
descriptions: A ReadLinkObjectEndQualifierAction is an Action that retrieves a qualifier end value from a link object.

definitions.name: ReadSelfAction.contained
descriptions: A ReadSelfAction must have a context Classifier.

definitions.name: ReadSelfAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the result OutputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReadSelfAction.not_static
descriptions: If the ReadSelfAction is contained in an Behavior that is acting as a method, then the Operation of the method must not be static.

expressions.body:
let behavior: Behavior = self.containingBehavior() in
behavior.specification<>null implies not behavior.specification.isStatic

definitions.name: ReadSelfAction.type
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is the context Classifier.

definitions.name: ReadSelfAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the context object is placed.

definitions.name: ReadSelfAction
descriptions: A ReadSelfAction is an Action that retrieves the context object of the Behavior execution within which the ReadSelfAction execution is taking place.

definitions.name: ReadStructuralFeatureAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the StructuralFeature must be compatible with the multiplicity of the result OutputPin.

definitions.name: ReadStructuralFeatureAction.type_and_ordering
descriptions: The type and ordering of the result OutputPin are the same as the type and ordering of the StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: ReadStructuralFeatureAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the result values are placed.

definitions.name: ReadStructuralFeatureAction
descriptions: A ReadStructuralFeatureAction is a StructuralFeatureAction that retrieves the values of a StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: ReadVariableAction.type_and_ordering
descriptions: The type and ordering of the result OutputPin are the same as the type and ordering of the variable.

definitions.name: ReadVariableAction.compatible_multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the variable must be compatible with the multiplicity of the output pin.

definitions.name: ReadVariableAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the result values are placed.

definitions.name: ReadVariableAction
descriptions: A ReadVariableAction is a VariableAction that retrieves the values of a Variable.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.input_pin
descriptions: The object InputPin has no type.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.classifier_not_abstract
descriptions: None of the newClassifiers may be abstract.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.isReplaceAll
descriptions: Specifies whether existing Classifiers should be removed before adding the new Classifiers.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.newClassifier
descriptions: A set of Classifiers to be added to the Classifiers of the given object.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin that holds the object to be reclassified.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction.oldClassifier
descriptions: A set of Classifiers to be removed from the Classifiers of the given object.

definitions.name: ReclassifyObjectAction
descriptions: A ReclassifyObjectAction is an Action that changes the Classifiers that classify an object.

definitions.name: ReduceAction.reducer_inputs_output
descriptions: The reducer Behavior must have two input ownedParameters and one output ownedParameter, where the type of the output Parameter and the type of elements of the input collection conform to the types of the input Parameters.

expressions.body:
let inputs: OrderedSet(Parameter) = reducer.inputParameters() in
let outputs: OrderedSet(Parameter) = reducer.outputParameters() in
inputs->size()=2 and outputs->size()=1 and
inputs.type->forAll(t | 
	outputs.type->forAll(conformsTo(t)) and 
	-- Note that the following only checks the case when the collection is via multiple tokens.
	collection.upperBound()>1 implies collection.type.conformsTo(t))

definitions.name: ReduceAction.input_type_is_collection
descriptions: The type of the collection InputPin must be a collection.
definitions.limitation: Multivalued pins represent token collections. A single token needs a registered domain collection type; missing collection-type evidence remains unsupported.

definitions.name: ReduceAction.output_types_are_compatible
descriptions: The type of the output of the reducer Behavior must conform to the type of the result OutputPin.

definitions.name: ReduceAction.collection
descriptions: The InputPin that provides the collection to be reduced.

definitions.name: ReduceAction.isOrdered
descriptions: Indicates whether the order of the input collection should determine the order in which the reducer Behavior is applied to its elements.

definitions.name: ReduceAction.reducer
descriptions: A Behavior that is repreatedly applied to two elements of the input collection to produce a value that is of the same type as elements of the collection.

definitions.name: ReduceAction.result
descriptions: The output pin on which the result value is placed.

definitions.name: ReduceAction
descriptions: A ReduceAction is an Action that reduces a collection to a single value by repeatedly combining the elements of the collection using a reducer Behavior.

definitions.name: RemoveStructuralFeatureValueAction.removeAt_and_value
descriptions: RemoveStructuralFeatureValueActions removing a value from ordered, non-unique StructuralFeatures must have a single removeAt InputPin and no value InputPin, if isRemoveDuplicates is false. The removeAt InputPin must be of type Unlimited Natural with multiplicity 1..1. Otherwise, the Action has a value InputPin and no removeAt InputPin.

expressions.body:
if structuralFeature.isOrdered and not structuralFeature.isUnique and  not isRemoveDuplicates then
  value = null and
  removeAt <> null and
  removeAt.type = UnlimitedNatural and
  removeAt.is(1,1)
else
  removeAt = null and value <> null
endif

definitions.name: RemoveStructuralFeatureValueAction.isRemoveDuplicates
descriptions: Specifies whether to remove duplicates of the value in nonunique StructuralFeatures.

definitions.name: RemoveStructuralFeatureValueAction.removeAt
descriptions: An InputPin that provides the position of an existing value to remove in ordered, nonunique structural features. The type of the removeAt InputPin is UnlimitedNatural, but the value cannot be zero or unlimited.

definitions.name: RemoveStructuralFeatureValueAction
descriptions: A RemoveStructuralFeatureValueAction is a WriteStructuralFeatureAction that removes values from a StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: RemoveVariableValueAction.removeAt_and_value
descriptions: ReadVariableActions removing a value from ordered, non-unique Variables must have a single removeAt InputPin and no value InputPin, if isRemoveDuplicates is false. The removeAt InputPin must be of type Unlimited Natural with multiplicity 1..1. Otherwise, the Action has a value InputPin and no removeAt InputPin.

expressions.body:
if  variable.isOrdered and not variable.isUnique and not isRemoveDuplicates then 
  value = null and
  removeAt <> null and
  removeAt.type = UnlimitedNatural and
  removeAt.is(1,1)
else
  removeAt = null and value <> null
endif

definitions.name: RemoveVariableValueAction.isRemoveDuplicates
descriptions: Specifies whether to remove duplicates of the value in nonunique Variables.

definitions.name: RemoveVariableValueAction.removeAt
descriptions: An InputPin that provides the position of an existing value to remove in ordered, nonunique Variables. The type of the removeAt InputPin is UnlimitedNatural, but the value cannot be zero or unlimited.

definitions.name: RemoveVariableValueAction
descriptions: A RemoveVariableValueAction is a WriteVariableAction that removes values from a Variables.

definitions.name: ReplyAction.pins_match_parameter
descriptions: The replyValue InputPins must match the output (return, out, and inout) parameters of the operation of the event of the replyToCall Trigger in number, type, ordering, and multiplicity.

expressions.body:
let parameter:OrderedSet(Parameter) = replyToCall.event.oclAsType(CallEvent).operation.outputParameters() in
replyValue->size()=parameter->size() and
Sequence{1..replyValue->size()}->forAll(i |
	replyValue->at(i).type.conformsTo(parameter->at(i).type) and
	replyValue->at(i).isOrdered=parameter->at(i).isOrdered and
	replyValue->at(i).compatibleWith(parameter->at(i)))

definitions.name: ReplyAction.event_on_reply_to_call_trigger
descriptions: The event of the replyToCall Trigger must be a CallEvent.

definitions.name: ReplyAction.replyToCall
descriptions: The Trigger specifying the Operation whose call is being replied to.

definitions.name: ReplyAction.replyValue
descriptions: A list of InputPins providing the values for the output (inout, out, and return) Parameters of the Operation. These values are returned to the caller.

definitions.name: ReplyAction.returnInformation
descriptions: An InputPin that holds the return information value produced by an earlier AcceptCallAction.

definitions.name: ReplyAction
descriptions: A ReplyAction is an Action that accepts a set of reply values and a value containing return information produced by a previous AcceptCallAction. The ReplyAction returns the values to the caller of the previous call, completing execution of the call.

definitions.name: SendObjectAction.type_target_pin
descriptions: If onPort is not empty, the Port given by onPort must be an owned or inherited feature of the type of the target InputPin.

definitions.name: SendObjectAction.request
descriptions: The request object, which is transmitted to the target object. The object may be copied in transmission, so identity might not be preserved.

definitions.name: SendObjectAction.target
descriptions: The target object to which the object is sent.

definitions.name: SendObjectAction
descriptions: A SendObjectAction is an InvocationAction that transmits an input object to the target object, which is handled as a request message by the target object. The requestor continues execution immediately after the object is sent out and cannot receive reply values.

definitions.name: SendSignalAction.type_ordering_multiplicity
descriptions: The type, ordering, and multiplicity of an argument InputPin must be the same as the corresponding attribute of the signal.

expressions.body:
let attribute: OrderedSet(Property) = signal.allAttributes() in
Sequence{1..argument->size()}->forAll(i | 
	argument->at(i).type.conformsTo(attribute->at(i).type) and 
	argument->at(i).isOrdered = attribute->at(i).isOrdered and
	argument->at(i).compatibleWith(attribute->at(i)))

definitions.name: SendSignalAction.number_order
descriptions: The number and order of argument InputPins must be the same as the number and order of attributes of the signal.

definitions.name: SendSignalAction.type_target_pin
descriptions: If onPort is not empty, the Port given by onPort must be an owned or inherited feature of the type of the target InputPin.

definitions.name: SendSignalAction.signal
descriptions: The Signal whose instance is transmitted to the target.

definitions.name: SendSignalAction.target
descriptions: The InputPin that provides the target object to which the Signal instance is sent.

definitions.name: SendSignalAction
descriptions: A SendSignalAction is an InvocationAction that creates a Signal instance and transmits it to the target object. Values from the argument InputPins are used to provide values for the attributes of the Signal. The requestor continues execution immediately after the Signal instance is sent out and cannot receive reply values.

definitions.name: SequenceNode.executableNode
descriptions: The ordered set of ExecutableNodes to be sequenced.

definitions.name: SequenceNode
descriptions: A SequenceNode is a StructuredActivityNode that executes a sequence of ExecutableNodes in order.

definitions.name: StartClassifierBehaviorAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1

definitions.name: StartClassifierBehaviorAction.type_has_classifier
descriptions: If the InputPin has a type, then the type or one of its ancestors must have a classifierBehavior.

definitions.name: StartClassifierBehaviorAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin that holds the object whose classifierBehavior is to be started.

definitions.name: StartClassifierBehaviorAction
descriptions: A StartClassifierBehaviorAction is an Action that starts the classifierBehavior of the input object.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.outputParameters
descriptions: Return the inout, out and return ownedParameters of the Behavior being called.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.inputParameters
descriptions: Return the in and inout ownedParameters of the Behavior being called.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.behavior
descriptions: If the type of the object InputPin is a Behavior, then that Behavior. Otherwise, if the type of the object InputPin is a BehavioredClassifier, then the classifierBehavior of that BehavioredClassifier.

expressions.body:
result = (if object.type.oclIsKindOf(Behavior) then
  object.type.oclAsType(Behavior)
else if object.type.oclIsKindOf(BehavioredClassifier) then
  object.type.oclAsType(BehavioredClassifier).classifierBehavior
else
  null
endif
endif)

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.multiplicity_of_object
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin must be 1..1.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.type_of_object
descriptions: The type of the object InputPin must be either a Behavior or a BehavioredClassifier with a classifierBehavior.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.no_onport
descriptions: A StartObjectBehaviorAction may not specify onPort.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction.object
descriptions: An InputPin that holds the object that is either a Behavior to be started or has a classifierBehavior to be started.

definitions.name: StartObjectBehaviorAction
descriptions: A StartObjectBehaviorAction is an InvocationAction that starts the execution either of a directly instantiated Behavior or of the classifierBehavior of an object. Argument values may be supplied for the input Parameters of the Behavior. If the Behavior is invoked synchronously, then output values may be obtained for output Parameters.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin must be 1..1.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.object_type
descriptions: The structuralFeature must either be an owned or inherited feature of the type of the object InputPin, or it must be an owned end of a binary Association whose opposite end had as a type to which the type of the object InputPin conforms.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.visibility
descriptions: The visibility of the structuralFeature must allow access from the object performing the ReadStructuralFeatureAction.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.not_static
descriptions: The structuralFeature must not be static.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.one_featuring_classifier
descriptions: The structuralFeature must have exactly one featuringClassifier.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin from which the object whose StructuralFeature is to be read or written is obtained.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction.structuralFeature
descriptions: The StructuralFeature to be read or written.

definitions.name: StructuralFeatureAction
descriptions: StructuralFeatureAction is an abstract class for all Actions that operate on StructuralFeatures.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.allActions
descriptions: Returns this StructuredActivityNode and all Actions contained in it.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.allOwnedNodes
descriptions: Returns all the ActivityNodes contained directly or indirectly within this StructuredActivityNode, in addition to the Pins of the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.sourceNodes
descriptions: Return those ActivityNodes contained immediately within the StructuredActivityNode that may act as sources of edges owned by the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.targetNodes
descriptions: Return those ActivityNodes contained immediately within the StructuredActivityNode that may act as targets of edges owned by the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.containingActivity
descriptions: The Activity that directly or indirectly contains this StructuredActivityNode (considered as an Action).

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.output_pin_edges
descriptions: The outgoing ActivityEdges of the OutputPins of a StructuredActivityNode must have targets that are not within the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.edges
descriptions: The edges of a StructuredActivityNode are all the ActivityEdges with source and target ActivityNodes contained directly or indirectly within the StructuredActivityNode and at least one of the source or target not contained in any more deeply nested StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.input_pin_edges
descriptions: The incoming ActivityEdges of an InputPin of a StructuredActivityNode must have sources that are not within the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.activity
descriptions: The Activity immediately containing the StructuredActivityNode, if it is not contained in another StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.edge
descriptions: The ActivityEdges immediately contained in the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.mustIsolate
descriptions: If true, then any object used by an Action within the StructuredActivityNode cannot be accessed by any Action outside the node until the StructuredActivityNode as a whole completes. Any concurrent Actions that would result in accessing such objects are required to have their execution deferred until the completion of the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.node
descriptions: The ActivityNodes immediately contained in the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.structuredNodeInput
descriptions: The InputPins owned by the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.structuredNodeOutput
descriptions: The OutputPins owned by the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode.variable
descriptions: The Variables defined in the scope of the StructuredActivityNode.

definitions.name: StructuredActivityNode
descriptions: A StructuredActivityNode is an Action that is also an ActivityGroup and whose behavior is specified by the ActivityNodes and ActivityEdges it so contains. Unlike other kinds of ActivityGroup, a StructuredActivityNode owns the ActivityNodes and ActivityEdges it contains, and so a node or edge can only be directly contained in one StructuredActivityNode, though StructuredActivityNodes may be nested.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction.multiplicity
descriptions: The multiplicity of the InputPins is 1..1.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction.no_type
descriptions: The InputPins have no type.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction.result_is_boolean
descriptions: The type of the result OutputPin is Boolean.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction.first
descriptions: The InputPin on which the first input object is placed.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPin whose Boolean value indicates whether the two input objects are identical.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction.second
descriptions: The OutputPin on which the second input object is placed.

definitions.name: TestIdentityAction
descriptions: A TestIdentityAction is an Action that tests if two values are identical objects.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.structural_feature
descriptions: The unmarshallType must have at least one StructuralFeature.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.number_of_result
descriptions: The number of result outputPins must be the same as the number of attributes of the unmarshallType.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.type_ordering_and_multiplicity
descriptions: The type, ordering and multiplicity of each attribute of the unmarshallType must be compatible with the type, ordering and multiplicity of the corresponding result OutputPin.

expressions.body:
let attribute:OrderedSet(Property) = unmarshallType.allAttributes() in
Sequence{1..result->size()}->forAll(i | 
	attribute->at(i).type.conformsTo(result->at(i).type) and
	attribute->at(i).isOrdered=result->at(i).isOrdered and
	attribute->at(i).compatibleWith(result->at(i)))

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.multiplicity_of_object
descriptions: The multiplicity of the object InputPin is 1..1

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.object_type
descriptions: The type of the object InputPin conform to the unmarshallType.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.object
descriptions: The InputPin that gives the object to be unmarshalled.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.result
descriptions: The OutputPins on which are placed the values of the StructuralFeatures of the input object.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction.unmarshallType
descriptions: The type of the object to be unmarshalled.

definitions.name: UnmarshallAction
descriptions: An UnmarshallAction is an Action that retrieves the values of the StructuralFeatures of an object and places them on OutputPins.

definitions.name: ValuePin.no_incoming_edges
descriptions: A ValuePin may have no incoming ActivityEdges.

definitions.name: ValuePin.compatible_type
descriptions: The type of the value ValueSpecification must conform to the type of the ValuePin.

definitions.name: ValuePin.value
descriptions: The ValueSpecification that is evaluated to obtain the value that the ValuePin will provide.

definitions.name: ValuePin
descriptions: A ValuePin is an InputPin that provides a value by evaluating a ValueSpecification.
ObjectNodeOrderingKind is an enumeration indicating queuing order for offering the tokens held by an ObjectNode.
ConnectorKind is an enumeration that defines whether a Connector is an assembly or a delegation.
PseudostateKind is an Enumeration type that is used to differentiate various kinds of Pseudostates.
TransitionKind is an Enumeration type used to differentiate the various kinds of Transitions.
Specifies the namespace in which the protocol state machine is defined.
definitions.name: interface

descriptions: InteractionOperatorKind is an enumeration designating the different kinds of operators of CombinedFragments. The InteractionOperand defines the type of operator of a CombinedFragment.
This is an enumerated type that identifies the type of Message.
This is an enumerated type that identifies the type of communication action that was used to generate the Message.
VisibilityKind is an enumeration type that defines literals to determine the visibility of Elements in a model.
Indicates the dependencies that reference the supplier.
definitions.name: supplierDependency

descriptions: AggregationKind is an Enumeration for specifying the kind of aggregation of a Property.
CallConcurrencyKind is an Enumeration used to specify the semantics of concurrent calls to a BehavioralFeature.
ParameterDirectionKind is an Enumeration that defines literals used to specify direction of parameters.
ParameterEffectKind is an Enumeration that indicates the effect of a Behavior on values passed in or out of its parameters.
ExpansionKind is an enumeration type used to specify how an ExpansionRegion executes its contents.

definitions.name: prose:ObjectFlow.selection_types
descriptions: Selection inputs accept source tokens; selection outputs conform to the source type.

definitions.name: prose:ObjectFlow.transformation_types
descriptions: Transformation inputs accept upstream tokens; outputs conform to downstream types.

definitions.name: prose:DecisionNode.input_types
descriptions: Decision inputs correspond to regular tokens first and decisionInputFlow tokens second, or accept the regular object flows through one parameter.

definitions.name: prose:Message.reply_argument_types
descriptions: Reply values or expression first operands conform to out/inout/return parameter types; wildcards are accepted.

definitions.name: prose:DeploymentSpecification.configured_instance_elements
descriptions: Configured deployments, including Artifact instances, manifest Components.

definitions.name: prose:DeploymentTarget.resolved_elements
descriptions: Resolve direct manifestations of Artifact objects and modeled Artifact instances.
